ReEDS GAMS to the Python port (pyoframe and linopy): per-constraint comparison

This page lists every equation of the ReEDS GAMS model (reeds/core/setup/c_model.gms and d_objective.gms) with, for each one, the GAMS source verbatim, the equation written out mathematically with every term, and the port code that builds the same row: the coefficient tables from reeds/open/prep.py, the row specification from reeds/open/algebra.py (one entry per equation: constant table, terms as coefficient table × variable with index rename, sum and post-rename, and the sense), and, where a coefficient is precomposed from input symbols, the derivation in reeds/open/derive_*.py. Two builders read the same specification: reeds/open/build_pyoframe.py (polars-backed pyoframe expressions) and reeds/open/build_linopy.py (xarray-backed linopy). The blue linopy box under each equation shows how that builder turns the specification into a sparse row: for each term the coefficient table, the variable with its index after renaming, the join key, and the row index after summation; the right-hand side is minus the constant table. The "GAMS term" table maps each term of the GAMS equation to its mathematical symbol and to the coefficient table that carries it in the port, and says whether the term is ported, folded into a precomposed coefficient, or absent.

Every port row is written as (GAMS left side) − (GAMS right side) = 0 or ≥ 0, so a positive coefficient in a table is a left-side term. GAMS stores no zeros and a $param condition means "nonzero"; the port keeps that rule: a missing coefficient removes a term, a constant that is zero still produces a row. GAMS CONVERT drops rows without variables and columns that appear in no row, and the port restricts its domains the same way.

Status badges: validated means the equation produced rows in at least one reference case and the matrix, bounds, objective, GAMS primal point and KKT conditions matched; ported, no rows means the port has code for the equation but both reference cases gave it zero rows in GAMS and in the port, so the code path has not been exercised against GAMS; not ported means the switch is off in both cases and prep.prepare raises if it is turned on.

Terms flagged no guard in a term table are GAMS terms the port drops without a check that would stop a run in which they are active. They are collected in the notes of the affected equations.

Notation

  • Upright names are variables (\(\V{CAP}_{i,v,r,t}\)), italic names are parameters (\(\P{avail}_{i,r,h}\)). Names keep their GAMS spelling.
  • \(\sw{Sw\_X}\) is 1 when switch Sw_X is on (or the stated condition holds) and 0 otherwise; a term multiplied by it is dropped by GAMS when it is 0.
  • \(\mathcal{T}=\mathrm{tfix}\cup\mathrm{tmodel}\) is the set of solved years; \(t\) is the current solve year, \(t^-\) the previous one (\(\mathrm{tprev}(t,t^-)\)). In the port \(\mathrm{tmodel}=\{t\}\), and sums over \(tt\in\mathcal{T},\ tt\le t\) split into the current-year variable plus a constant built from the prior-year levels (state_* tables read from the GAMS solution gdx of the previous year).
  • \(h_{rep}\), \(h_{stress}\): representative and stress timeslices; \(\P{hours}_h\) their weights; \(\P{hd}_h=\P{hours\_daily}_h\).
  • Sums are over the GAMS $-conditions written under the sum sign; set memberships such as \(\mathrm{valgen}(i,v,r,t)\) are written as \((i,v)\in\mathrm{valgen}_{r,t}\).
  • Precomposed coefficients: \(\kappa\) (capacity-limit availability), \(\kappa^{s}\) (storage capacity), \(d\) (storage duration), \(\P{rsc\_cap}\) (gross supply-curve capacity), \(\P{prescr}\) (degraded prescribed retirements), \(c^{inv}_\bullet\), \(c^{op}_\bullet\) (objective coefficients) are computed once in derive_*.py; the code is shown with the equation that uses them.

Syntax: GAMS constructs and their polars / pyoframe / linopy form

The port expresses GAMS sets and parameters as polars tables (index columns plus value) and GAMS conditions as joins. The table below lists each idiom once; each equation section repeats the helpers and operations its code uses, and helper names in the code excerpts link to their definitions under Shared helpers.

GAMSPort (polars / pyoframe)Meaning
eq_x(r,h,t).. sum{...} =g= constlinopy: _add_row builds a LinearExpression over (eq_x_idx, _term)Every variable has one flat integer coordinate (its position in the prep domain). A row is the padded list of (coefficient, column label) pairs; a label of −1 means no variable. add_constraints(expr, sign, rhs) adds the row with rhs = −const.
coef(i,r) * CAP(i,v,r,t) in a rowlinopy: _term_entries inner join of the coefficient table with the variable domainSame join as pyoframe's parameter times variable, written out: the shared index columns are the join key, the variable's position becomes the column label, and sum_by groups the entries to the row index.
GAMS marginal / reduced costlinopy: m.dual[eq]; c − Aᵀy from m.matricesDuals come from HiGHS through linopy in constraint-label order; reduced costs are recomputed from the matrices because linopy does not expose them.
sum{(i,v)$valgen(i,v,r,t), GEN(i,v,r,h,t)}m.GEN.to_expr().within(K[...]).sum_by("r", "h", "t")Restrict a variable to the labels of a table (the $-condition), then sum out the indices that are not kept. to_expr turns the variable into an expression, within filters it, sum_by keeps the named dimensions.
coef(i,r) * CAP(i,v,r,t)P(K["coef"]) * m.CAPParameter times variable is an inner join on the shared index columns; a missing coefficient drops the term, like a zero GAMS parameter.
term_a + term_b over different domainsU(a, b), which is a.keep_extras() + b.keep_extras()pyoframe refuses to add expressions whose labels differ unless told how; keep_extras keeps a label present on one side and the other side contributes 0.
CAP(i,v,r,t) - GEN(i,v,r,h,t) where GEN has extra labels... - m.GEN.drop_extras()Drop the labels of GEN that are not on the domain of the other side: a $-filter on the variable.
FLOW(rr,r,h,t,trtype) (indices swapped)m.FLOW.rename({"r": "rr", "rr": "r"})Rename index columns so the variable lines up with the row index, for example imports into r.
STORAGE_LEVEL(i,v,r,hh,t)$nexth(h,hh)m.STORAGE_LEVEL.rename({"h": "hh"}).map(K["nexth"])Map one index onto another through a mapping table (h to its successor hh).
eq(...).. lhs =g= rhsm.eq = expr >= 0 with expr = lhs − rhsEvery row is written as (left side) − (right side) against 0, so the solver dual carries the GAMS marginal sign.
$[set(i)] on a table_in(df, "i", S["set"]) or semi(df, set_table, keys)Keep rows by membership: _in tests one column against a Python set, semi tests several key columns against a table.
$[not set(i)]_not_in(...) or anti(...)The complement of the row above.
param(i,r) read where missing = 0df.join(par, on=keys, how="left") then fill_null(0.0); _on_domain; lookupA left join keeps every row of the domain and a missing parameter value becomes 0.
a(i) + b(i) as data_add(left, right, on)Left join right onto left and add; a missing right value is 0.
a(i) * b(i) as data_mul(left, right, on)Inner join and multiply; a missing factor removes the row.
sum{j, x(i,j)} as data_fsum(df, keys), fsum_by(df, keys), group_by(keys).agg(pl.col("value").sum())Group-by sum over the dropped index; the fsum versions are used where the result must match GAMS to the last digit.
x(i)$cond = expr_assign(target, new, keys, domain)Conditional assignment: replace the rows inside the domain, keep the rows outside.
(i,j) over whole setsa.join(b, how="cross") or cross(a, b)Cartesian product of index sets.
GAMS stores no zerosnonzero(df) or filter(pl.col("value") != 0.0)A stored zero would otherwise create a term or a row that GAMS does not have.
round(x, n)gams_round(expr, n)Half away from zero, as in GAMS.
yeart(tt) <= yeart(t)yr("tt") <= yr("t")Years are strings in the tables and are cast to integers to compare them.

Defines busbar load so that its dual is the marginal energy price. Only the exogenous load, Canada exports and production load are active.

\(\displaystyle \V{LOAD}_{r,h,t}\)\(\displaystyle =\; \P{load\_exog\_static}_{r,h,t}\)\(\displaystyle + \P{can\_exports\_h}_{r,h,t}\,\sw{Sw\_Canada=1}\)\(\displaystyle + \P{evmc\_baseline\_load}_{r,h,t}\,\sw{Sw\_EVMC}\)\(\displaystyle + \sum_{(i,v)\in\mathrm{evmc\_shape}\cap\mathrm{valcap}_{r,t}} \P{evmc\_shape\_load}_{i,r,h}\,\V{CAP}_{i,v,r,t}\)\(\displaystyle + \sum_{f}\V{FLEX}_{f,r,h,t}\,\sw{Sw\_EFS\_flex}\)\(\displaystyle + \sum_{\substack{(p,i,v):\ i\in\mathrm{consume},\ (i,v,r,t)\in\mathrm{valcap},\\ \mathrm{i\_p}(i,p),\ i\neq\text{dac\_gas}}} \frac{\V{PRODUCE}_{p,i,v,r,h,t}}{\P{prod\_conversion\_rate}_{i,v,r,t}}\;\sw{Sw\_Prod}\,[h\in h_{rep}]\)\(\displaystyle + \Big(\sum_{s\in\mathrm{h2\_stor\_r}(r)} \P{h2\_network\_load}_{s,t}(\V{H2\_STOR\_IN}+\V{H2\_STOR\_OUT})_{s,r,h,t} + \sum_{rr\in\mathrm{h2\_routes}(r)} \P{h2\_network\_load}_{\text{comp},t}\tfrac{\V{H2\_FLOW}_{r,rr,h,t}+\V{H2\_FLOW}_{rr,r,h,t}}{2}\Big)\sw{Sw\_H2\_CompressorLoad}\)\(\displaystyle + \V{OP\_LOADSITE}_{r,h,t}\,[0<\mathrm{Sw\_LoadSiteCF}<1]\)\(\displaystyle + \V{CAP\_LOADSITE}_{r,t}\,[\mathrm{Sw\_LoadSiteCF}=1]\)

eq_loadcon(r,h,t)$tmodel(t)..

    LOAD(r,h,t)

    =e=

*[plus] the static, exogenous load
    + load_exog_static(r,h,t)

*[plus] exogenously defined exports to Canada
* note net canadian load (when Sw_Canada = 2) is included
* in eq_supply_demand since LOAD needs to stay positive
* while net_trade can be negative and cause infeasibilities
    + can_exports_h(r,h,t)$[Sw_Canada=1]

*[plus] load from EV charging (baseline/unmanaged)
    + evmc_baseline_load(r,h,t)$Sw_EVMC

*[plus] shifted load from adopted EVMC shape resources
    + sum{(i,v)$[evmc_shape(i)$valcap(i,v,r,t)], evmc_shape_load(i,r,h) * CAP(i,v,r,t)}

*[plus] load shifted from other timeslices
    + sum{flex_type, FLEX(flex_type,r,h,t) }$Sw_EFS_flex

*[plus] Load created by production activities - only tracked during representative hours
* [metric tons/hour] / [metric tons/MWh] = [MW]
    + sum{(p,i,v)$[consume(i)$valcap(i,v,r,t)$i_p(i,p)$(not sameas(i,"dac_gas"))],
          PRODUCE(p,i,v,r,h,t) / prod_conversion_rate(i,v,r,t) }$[Sw_Prod$h_rep(h)]

*[plus] load for compressors associated with hydrogen storage injections or withdrawals
* metric tons/hour * MWh/metric tons = MW
    + sum{h2_stor$h2_stor_r(h2_stor,r),
        h2_network_load(h2_stor,t)
        * ( H2_STOR_IN(h2_stor,r,h,t) + H2_STOR_OUT(h2_stor,r,h,t) ) }$Sw_H2_CompressorLoad

* [plus] load for hydrogen pipeline compressors
* metric tons/hour * MWh/metric tons = MW
    + sum{rr$h2_routes(r,rr),
        h2_network_load("h2_compressor",t)
        * (( H2_FLOW(r,rr,h,t) + H2_FLOW(rr,r,h,t) ) / 2) }$Sw_H2_CompressorLoad

* Operations of flexibly sited load:
* - OP_LOADSITE is used when 0 < Sw_LoadSiteCF < 1
* - CAP_LOADSITE is used when Sw_LoadSiteCF = 1 because OP_LOADSITE = CAP_LOADSITE
*   (the effect is the same but avoiding the h-indexed OP_LOADSITE reduces solve time)
    + OP_LOADSITE(r,h,t)$[Sw_LoadSiteCF$(Sw_LoadSiteCF<1)$val_loadsite(r)]
    + CAP_LOADSITE(r,t)$[(Sw_LoadSiteCF=1)$val_loadsite(r)]
;

rhs = −K[load_neg] joined onto the rows (0 where the constant table has no row). Each (row, column) pair is summed before packing, zero coefficients are dropped, and the column label is the variable's position in its prep domain.

Helpers in this code: _on_domain, _add, _signed, _row, _term_entries, _add_row

pyoframe and polars operations in this code (syntax reference)
  • how="inner": keep matching rows of both (a missing factor removes the row)
Notes
  • The row domain is every (r, h, t) with t in tmodel, as in GAMS (no $-condition beyond tmodel).
  • PRODUCE columns exist only for representative hours, so the h_rep condition is carried by the column domain.

* generation from all land-based sources, including storage discharge
    sum{(i,v)$[valgen(i,v,r,t)$land(r)], GEN(i,v,r,h,t) }

* [plus] net AC and LCC DC transmission with imports reduced by losses
    + sum{(trtype,rr)$[routes(rr,r,trtype,t)$notvsc(trtype)],
          (1-tranloss(rr,r,trtype)) * FLOW(rr,r,h,t,trtype) }
    - sum{(trtype,rr)$[routes(r,rr,trtype,t)$notvsc(trtype)],
          FLOW(r,rr,h,t,trtype) }

* [plus] net AC/DC conversion through VSC converter stations
* Note that we only need "AC" in the CONVERSION variable (not LCC, B2B, etc)
* since all it does here is act as a catch-all for "not VSC"
    + (CONVERSION(r,h,"VSC","AC",t) * converter_efficiency_vsc)$[Sw_VSC$val_converter(r,t)]
    - (CONVERSION(r,h,"AC","VSC",t) / converter_efficiency_vsc)$[Sw_VSC$val_converter(r,t)]

* [minus] storage charging; not hybrid+storage

P.coef["bal_import"] = (                                 # (1 - tranloss) on FLOW(r->rr), AC and LCC routes only
    routes_notvsc.join(case["tranloss"], on=["r", "rr", "trtype"], how="left")
    .with_columns((1.0 - pl.col("value").fill_null(0.0)).alias("value"))

dispatch = members(S.dispatchtech)
hydro_d = members(S.hydro_d)
seas = (S.h_szn.join(S.seas_cap_frac_delta.filter(pl.col("t") == year).rename({"value": "d"}), on="szn", how="inner")
        .select(["i", "v", "r", "h", "d"]))
base = valgen_y.join(h, how="cross").join(S.avail.rename({"value": "avail"}), on=["i", "r", "h"], how="left").with_columns(pl.col("avail").fill_null(0.0))
base = base.join(seas, on=["i", "v", "r", "h"], how="left").with_columns(pl.col("d").fill_null(0.0))
base = base.join(S.derate_geo_vintage.rename({"value": "dgv"}), on=["i", "v"], how="left").with_columns(pl.col("dgv").fill_null(0.0))
chsa = S.h_szn.join(S.cap_hyd_szn_adj.rename({"value": "hadj"}), on="szn", how="inner").select(["i", "r", "h", "hadj"])
base = base.join(chsa, on=["i", "r", "h"], how="left").with_columns(pl.col("hadj").fill_null(0.0))
hcd = S.hydro_capcredit_delta.filter(pl.col("t") == year).rename({"value": "hcd"}).select(["i", "hcd"])
base = base.join(hcd, on="i", how="left").with_columns(pl.col("hcd").fill_null(0.0))
mcf = fsum_by(S.m_cf.filter(pl.col("t") == year), ["i", "v", "r", "h", "t"]).rename({"value": "mcf"})
base = base.join(mcf, on=["i", "v", "r", "h", "t"], how="left").with_columns(pl.col("mcf").fill_null(0.0))
term1 = pl.when(isin("i", dispatch - hydro_d)).then(pl.col("avail") * pl.col("dgv") * (1.0 + pl.col("d"))).otherwise(0.0)
term2 = pl.when(isin("i", hydro_d)).then(pl.col("avail") * pl.col("hadj") * (1.0 + pl.when(isin("h", h_stress)).then(pl.col("hcd")).otherwise(0.0))).otherwise(0.0)
term3 = pl.when(~isin("i", dispatch)).then(pl.col("mcf")).otherwise(0.0)
S["slice_cap_coef"] = nonzero(base.with_columns((term1 + term2 + term3).alias("value")).select(["i", "v", "r", "h", "t", "value"]))

derive_temporal.py:366
years = {str(y) for y in S.years}

def prescr(ret: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    cond = S.inv_cond.rename({"t": "tt", "tt": "ttt"}).filter(isin("tt", years) & isin("ttt", years))
    cond = semi(cond, valcap_y.select(["i", "v", "r"]).unique(), ["i", "v", "r"])
    cond = semi(cond, S.valcap.rename({"t": "ttt"}), ["i", "v", "r", "ttt"])
    cond = cond.filter((yr("tt") >= yr("ttt")) & (yr("tt") <= int(year)))
    dn = S.degrade_new.rename({"t": "ttt", "tt": "tt", "value": "dn"})
    j = (cond.join(dn, on=["i", "ttt", "tt"], how="inner")
         .join(ret.rename({"t": "tt", "tt": "ttt", "value": "ret"}), on=["i", "v", "r", "tt", "ttt"], how="inner")
         .with_columns((pl.col("dn") * pl.col("ret")).alias("value"), pl.lit(year).alias("t")))
    return nonzero(fsum_by(j, V4))

S["slice_prescr_ret"] = prescr(S.prescribed_retirements)
S["slice_prescr_ret_energy"] = prescr(S.prescribed_retirements_energy)

prep.py:140
rsc_agg = case["rsc_agg"]  # (i, ii): i is the numeraire tech, ii the investing tech
lim_dom = (
    _in(case["m_rscfeas"], "i", S["rsc_i"])
    .join(case["m_rsc_con"], on=["r", "i"], how="semi")
    .join(tmodel, how="cross")
    .select(["r", "i", "rscbin", "t"])
)
gross = _on_domain(lim_dom, case["slice_rsc_cap"], ["r", "i", "rscbin", "t"])
past = (
    case["state_INV_RSC"]
    .join(tfix.rename({"t": "tt"}), on="tt", how="semi")
    .rename({"i": "ii"})
    .join(rsc_agg, on="ii", how="inner")
    .join(case["resourcescaler"].rename({"i": "ii", "value": "scaler"}), on="ii", how="left")
    .with_columns((pl.col("value") * pl.col("scaler").fill_null(0.0)).alias("value"))
    .join(tmodel, how="cross")
    .filter(pl.col("tt") <= pl.col("t"))
    .group_by(["r", "i", "rscbin", "t"])
    .agg(pl.col("value").sum())
)
rhs = (
    gross.join(past.rename({"value": "past"}), on=["r", "i", "rscbin", "t"], how="left")
    .with_columns((pl.col("value") - pl.col("past").fill_null(0.0)).alias("value"))
    .drop("past")
)
tol = case.scalar("rhs_tolerance")
flagged = rhs.filter(pl.col("value").abs() < tol)
# GAMS fixes INV_RSC(ii,v,r,rscbin,t)=0 for flagged bins; holdfixed=1 removes them.
fixed = (
    flagged.join(rsc_agg, on="i", how="inner")
    .select(pl.col("ii").alias("i"), "r", "rscbin", "t")
    .unique()
)
P.var["INV_RSC"] = inv_rsc.join(fixed, on=["i", "r", "rscbin", "t"], how="anti")
lim_rows = rhs.join(flagged, on=["r", "i", "rscbin", "t"], how="anti").select(["r", "i", "rscbin", "t"])
# term: resourcescaler(ii) * INV_RSC(ii,v,r,rscbin,t) contributes to row (r,i,rscbin,t)
P.coef["rsc_lim_use"] = (
    P.var["INV_RSC"].rename({"i": "ii"})
    .join(rsc_agg, on="ii", how="inner")
    .join(lim_rows, on=["r", "i", "rscbin", "t"], how="semi")

pyoframe and polars operations in this code (syntax reference)
  • .rename({...}): rename index columns to line up with the row

prep.py:395
if sw_fp:
    fp_dom = _in(case["force_prescribe"].join(valinv, on=V4, how="semi"), "v", S["newv"]).select(V4)
    fy = case["firstyear"].rename({"value": "fy"})
    k1 = (fp_dom.join(fy, on="i", how="left")
          .with_columns(pl.when(pl.col("t") >= pl.col("fy").fill_null(0.0)).then(1.0).otherwise(0.0).alias("k1")).drop("fy"))
    off = (_in(fp_dom, "i", case.members("ofswind"))
           .join(case["r_offshore"], on=["r", "t"], how="semi")
           .filter(pl.col("t") >= case.scalar("firstyear_RPS"))
           .join(case["r_st"], on="r", how="inner")
           .join(case["offshore_cap_req"], on=["st", "t"], how="inner")
           .select(V4).unique().with_columns(pl.lit(1.0).alias("k2")))
    k = (k1.join(off, on=V4, how="left").with_columns((pl.col("k1") + pl.col("k2").fill_null(0.0)).alias("value"))
         .select(V4 + ["value"]).filter(pl.col("value") != 0.0))
    P.con["eq_forceprescription_power"] = fp_dom
    P.coef["fp_build"] = _on_domain(fp_dom, case["prescribed_build"], V4).with_columns((-pl.col("value")).alias("value"))
    P.coef["fp_inv"] = _signed(fp_dom, V4, 1.0)
    P.coef["fp_refurb"] = (_signed(P.var["INV_REFURB"].join(fp_dom, on=V4, how="semi"), V4, 1.0)
                           if "INV_REFURB" in P.var else _signed(fp_dom.head(0), V4, 1.0))
    P.coef["fp_extra"] = k.with_columns((-pl.col("value")).alias("value"))
    P.var["EXTRA_PRESCRIP"] = k.select(V4)
    fpe_dom = _in(fp_dom, "i", S["battery"])
    P.con["eq_forceprescription_energy"] = fpe_dom
    P.coef["fpe_build"] = _on_domain(fpe_dom, case["prescribed_build_energy"], V4).with_columns((-pl.col("value")).alias("value"))
    P.coef["fpe_inv"] = _signed(fpe_dom, V4, 1.0)
    ke = k1.filter(pl.col("k1") != 0.0).join(fpe_dom, on=V4, how="semi").select(V4)
    P.coef["fpe_extra"] = _signed(ke, V4, -1.0)
    P.var["EXTRA_PRESCRIP_ENERGY"] = ke

pyoframe and polars operations in this code (syntax reference)
  • .rename({...}): rename index columns to line up with the row
  • how="semi": keep rows whose keys are in the other table ($-condition)
  • how="inner": keep matching rows of both (a missing factor removes the row)
  • how="left": keep every row of the left table (missing values become null, then 0)
  • fill_null(0.0): a missing GAMS parameter is 0
  • .unique(): distinct rows, so a domain has no duplicates
  • pl.when(c).then(a).otherwise(b): elementwise conditional (GAMS $ on a value)

mrc = case["m_refurb_cond"].join(tmodel, on="t", how="semi")
cur_inv = (mrc.join(tmodel_tt, on="tt", how="semi")
           .join(P.var["INV"].rename({"t": "tt"}), on=["i", "v", "r", "tt"], how="semi")
           .select(["i", "r", "t", pl.col("v").alias("vv")]).with_columns(pl.lit(1.0).alias("value")))
past_inv = (mrc.join(tfix_tt, on="tt", how="semi").join(valinv_tfix, on=["i", "v", "r", "tt"], how="semi")
            .join(case["state_INV"], on=["i", "v", "r", "tt"], how="inner").group_by(["i", "r", "t"]).agg(pl.col("value").sum()))
avail = (case["avail_retire_exog_rsc"].rename({"t": "tt"}).join(tmodel, how="cross").filter(pl.col("tt") <= pl.col("t"))
         .group_by(["i", "r", "t"]).agg(pl.col("value").sum()))
icond = case["inv_cond"].join(tmodel, on="t", how="semi")
cur_ref = (icond.join(tmodel_tt, on="tt", how="semi")
           .join(P.var["INV_REFURB"].rename({"t": "tt"}), on=["i", "v", "r", "tt"], how="semi")
           .select(["i", "r", "t", pl.col("v").alias("vv")]).with_columns(pl.lit(-1.0).alias("value")))
past_ref = (icond.join(tfix_tt, on="tt", how="semi").join(valinv_tfix, on=["i", "v", "r", "tt"], how="semi")
            .join(case["state_INV_REFURB"], on=["i", "v", "r", "tt"], how="inner").group_by(["i", "r", "t"]).agg(pl.col("value").sum()))
rl_rows = (pl.concat([cur_inv.select(["i", "r", "t"]), cur_ref.select(["i", "r", "t"])]).unique()
           .join(rl_dom, on=["i", "r", "t"], how="semi"))

P.coef["refurblim_refurb"] = cur_ref
P.con["eq_refurblim"] = rl_rows

uy = case.scalar("Sw_UpgradeYear")
caa = case.scalar("caa_coal_retire_year")
up_dom = P.var["UPGRADES"]
from_ok = (up_dom.join(case["upgrade_from"], on="i", how="inner")
           .join(valcap.rename({"i": "ii"}), on=["ii", "v", "r", "t"], how="semi").select(V4).unique())
cur = (from_ok.filter((pl.col("t") >= uy) & (~pl.col("i").is_in(list(coal)) | (pl.col("t") <= caa)))
       .join(case["upgrade_derate"], on=V4, how="left")
       .with_columns((1.0 - pl.col("value").fill_null(0.0)).alias("value")))
from_ok_fix = (case["state_UPGRADES"].join(valcap_tfix, on=["i", "v", "r", "tt"], how="semi")
               .join(case["upgrade_from"], on="i", how="inner")
               .join(valcap_tfix.rename({"i": "ii"}), on=["ii", "v", "r", "tt"], how="semi")
               .select(["i", "v", "r", "tt", "value"]).unique(subset=["i", "v", "r", "tt"]))
past = (from_ok_fix.join(tmodel, how="cross")
        .filter((pl.col("tt") >= uy) & (pl.col("tt") <= pl.col("t")) & (~pl.col("i").is_in(list(coal)) | (pl.col("tt") <= caa)))
        .join(case["upgrade_derate"].rename({"t": "tt", "value": "derate"}), on=["i", "v", "r", "tt"], how="left")
        .with_columns((pl.col("value") * (1.0 - pl.col("derate").fill_null(0.0))).alias("value"))
        .group_by(V4).agg(pl.col("value").sum()))
ret_past = (_not_in(case["state_UPGRADES_RETIRE"], "i", noret).join(valcap_tfix, on=["i", "v", "r", "tt"], how="semi")
            .join(tmodel, how="cross").group_by(V4).agg(pl.col("value").sum()))
const = _add(_on_domain(up_dom, past, V4), ret_past, V4, sign=-1.0)
P.con["eq_cap_upgrade"] = up_dom
P.coef["cap_upgrade_const"] = const
P.coef["cap_upgrade_up"] = cur.select(V4 + ["value"])
P.coef["cap_upgrade_ret"] = _signed(P.var["UPGRADES_RETIRE"], V4, -1.0)
P.coef["cap_upgrade_cap"] = _signed(up_dom, V4, -1.0)

    $[tmodel(t)$Sw_OpRes$opres_model(ortype)$opres_h(h)]..

*operating reserves from technologies that can produce them (i.e. those w/ramp rates)

    sum{(i,v)$[valgen(i,v,r,t)$reserve_frac(i,ortype)],
         OPRES(ortype,i,v,r,h,t) }

*[plus] net transmission of operating reserves (while including losses for imports)
    + sum{rr$opres_routes(rr,r,t), (1 - tranloss(rr,r,"AC")) * OPRES_FLOW(ortype,rr,r,h,t) }
    - sum{rr$opres_routes(r,rr,t), OPRES_FLOW(ortype,r,rr,h,t) }

*[plus] dropped load (operating reserves) ONLY if before Sw_StartMarkets
    + DROPPED(r,h,t)$[(yeart(t)<Sw_StartMarkets) or (Sw_PCM=1)]

    =g=

*must meet the demand for or type
*first portion is from load
    orperc(ortype,"or_load") * LOAD(r,h,t)

*next portion is from the wind generation
    + orperc(ortype,"or_wind") * sum{(i,v)$[wind(i)$valgen(i,v,r,t)],
        GEN(i,v,r,h,t) }

*final portion is from upv, and distpv capacity
*note that pv capacity is held at the balancing area
*include the hybrid PV+battery PV capacity here
    + orperc(ortype,"or_pv") * sum{(i,v)$[(pv(i) or pvb(i))$valcap(i,v,r,t)],
         CAP(i,v,r,t) / ilr(i) }$dayhours(h)

                          .with_columns((1.0 - pl.col("loss").fill_null(0.0)).alias("value")).select(["ortype", "r", "rr", "h", "t", "value"]))
P.coef["opres_export"] = _signed(P.var["OPRES_FLOW"], ["ortype", "r", "rr", "h", "t"], -1.0)
orp = case["orperc"]

def orp_val(cat):

derive_costs.py:23
def gas_curve(S: Symbols) -> Symbols:
    I = S._inputs
    sc, csw = S.sc, S.csw
    year = str(S.year)
    t_all = S.t
    cendiv = I.set("cendiv", ["cendiv"])
    fuelbin = I.set("fuelbin", ["fuelbin"])
    S["cendiv"] = cendiv
    S["fuelbin"] = fuelbin
    S["r_cendiv"] = S.hierarchy.select(["r", "cendiv"]).unique()
    t_vals = sorted(int(x) for x in t_all["t"].to_list())
    if t_vals != list(range(t_vals[0], t_vals[-1] + 1)):
        raise ValueError("the t set must be consecutive years for the two-year gas lag (t-2) to be a year offset")
    supply = semi(I.par("ng_demand_elec", ["cendiv", "allt"]).rename({"allt": "t"}), t_all, ["t"])
    supply = nonzero(semi(supply, cendiv, ["cendiv"]).with_columns((1e9 * pl.col("value")).alias("value")))
    S["gassupply_ele"] = supply
    usage = fsum_by(supply.select(["t", "value"]), ["t"])
    S["gasusage_national"] = nonzero(usage)
    sector = csw["GSw_GasSector"]
    if sector == "energy_sector":
        beta0 = I.par("cd_beta0_allsector", ["cendiv"])
        nat_beta_val = sc["nat_beta_energy"]
    elif sector == "electric_sector":
        beta0 = I.par("cd_beta0", ["cendiv"])
        nat_beta_val = sc["nat_beta_nonenergy"]
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"GSw_GasSector={sector!r} is not electric_sector or energy_sector")
    t_after = t_all.filter(yr("t") > 2010)
    cd_beta = nonzero(semi(beta0, cendiv, ["cendiv"]).join(t_after, how="cross").select(["cendiv", "t", "value"]))
    nat_beta = t_after.with_columns(pl.lit(float(nat_beta_val)).alias("value"))
    S["cd_beta"] = cd_beta
    S["nat_beta"] = nat_beta
    n = fuelbin.height
    width = (sc["normfuelbinmax"] - sc["normfuelbinmin"]) / (n - 2)
    bot = sc["normfuelbinmin"]
    top = sc["topfuelbinwidth"]
    ordf = fuelbin.with_row_index("ord", offset=1).with_columns(pl.col("ord").cast(pl.Float64))
    binmult = pl.when(pl.col("ord") == 1).then(bot).when(pl.col("ord") == n).then(top).otherwise(width)
    qq_frac = bot + (pl.col("ord") - 1) * width - width / 2
    dom_reg = ordf.join(cendiv, how="cross").join(t_all, how="cross")
    reg = (dom_reg.join(supply.rename({"value": "sup"}), on=["cendiv", "t"], how="left")
           .join(cd_beta.rename({"value": "beta"}), on=["cendiv", "t"], how="left")
           .with_columns(pl.col("sup").fill_null(0.0), pl.col("beta").fill_null(0.0)))
    gbw_reg = reg.with_columns((pl.col("sup") * binmult).alias("value"))
    gbw_reg = gbw_reg.with_columns(pl.when(pl.col("value") < 10.0).then(10.0).otherwise(pl.col("value")).alias("value"))
    S["gasbinwidth_regional"] = gbw_reg.select(["fuelbin", "cendiv", "t", "value"])
    gbp_reg = (reg.with_columns((pl.col("sup") * qq_frac).alias("qq"))
               .with_columns(gams_round((pl.col("beta") * (pl.col("qq") - pl.col("sup"))) / 1e9, 5).alias("value")))
    S["gasbinp_regional"] = nonzero(gbp_reg.select(["fuelbin", "cendiv", "t", "value"]))
    dom_nat = ordf.join(t_all, how="cross")
    nat = (dom_nat.join(usage.rename({"value": "use"}), on="t", how="left").join(nat_beta.rename({"value": "beta"}), on="t", how="left")
           .with_columns(pl.col("use").fill_null(0.0), pl.col("beta").fill_null(0.0)))
    S["gasbinwidth_national"] = nonzero(nat.with_columns((pl.col("use") * binmult).alias("value")).select(["fuelbin", "t", "value"]))
    gbp_nat = (nat.with_columns((pl.col("use") * qq_frac).alias("qq"))
               .with_columns(gams_round(pl.col("beta") * (pl.col("qq") - pl.col("use")) / 1e9, 5).alias("value")))
    S["gasbinp_national"] = nonzero(gbp_nat.select(["fuelbin", "t", "value"]))
    alpha = semi(I.par("alpha", ["allt", "cendiv"]).rename({"allt": "t"}), t_all, ["t"])
    lag = t_all.with_columns((yr("t") - 2).cast(pl.Int64).cast(pl.Utf8).alias("tlag"))
    gmt = (cendiv.join(t_all, how="cross").join(lag, on="t", how="inner")
           .join(alpha.rename({"value": "alpha"}), on=["t", "cendiv"], how="left")
           .join(nat_beta.rename({"value": "nb"}), on="t", how="left")
           .join(usage.rename({"value": "use", "t": "tlag"}), on="tlag", how="left")
           .join(cd_beta.rename({"value": "cb"}), on=["cendiv", "t"], how="left")
           .join(supply.rename({"value": "sup", "t": "tlag"}), on=["cendiv", "tlag"], how="left")
           .with_columns([pl.col(c).fill_null(0.0) for c in ["alpha", "nb", "use", "cb", "sup"]])
           .with_columns((pl.col("alpha") + pl.col("nb") * pl.col("use") / 1e9 + pl.col("cb") * pl.col("sup") / 1e9).alias("value")))
    S["gasmultterm"] = nonzero(gmt.select(["cendiv", "t", "value"])).with_columns(gams_round(pl.col("value"), 3).alias("value"))
    weights = semi(I.par("cendivweights", ["r", "cendiv"]), cendiv, ["cendiv"])
    S["cendiv_weights"] = nonzero(weights).with_columns(gams_round(pl.col("value"), 3).alias("value"))
    S["gasmult_r"] = nonzero(fsum_by(S.cendiv_weights.rename({"value": "w"}).join(S.gasmultterm, on="cendiv", how="inner")
                                     .with_columns((pl.col("value") * pl.col("w")).alias("value")).select(["r", "t", "value"]), ["r", "t"]))
    S["slice_objop_VGASBINQ_REGIONAL"] = S.gasbinp_regional.filter(pl.col("t") == year)
    S["slice_objop_VGASBINQ_NATIONAL"] = S.gasbinp_national.filter(pl.col("t") == year)
    return S

derive_costs.py:23
def gas_curve(S: Symbols) -> Symbols:
    I = S._inputs
    sc, csw = S.sc, S.csw
    year = str(S.year)
    t_all = S.t
    cendiv = I.set("cendiv", ["cendiv"])
    fuelbin = I.set("fuelbin", ["fuelbin"])
    S["cendiv"] = cendiv
    S["fuelbin"] = fuelbin
    S["r_cendiv"] = S.hierarchy.select(["r", "cendiv"]).unique()
    t_vals = sorted(int(x) for x in t_all["t"].to_list())
    if t_vals != list(range(t_vals[0], t_vals[-1] + 1)):
        raise ValueError("the t set must be consecutive years for the two-year gas lag (t-2) to be a year offset")
    supply = semi(I.par("ng_demand_elec", ["cendiv", "allt"]).rename({"allt": "t"}), t_all, ["t"])
    supply = nonzero(semi(supply, cendiv, ["cendiv"]).with_columns((1e9 * pl.col("value")).alias("value")))
    S["gassupply_ele"] = supply
    usage = fsum_by(supply.select(["t", "value"]), ["t"])
    S["gasusage_national"] = nonzero(usage)
    sector = csw["GSw_GasSector"]
    if sector == "energy_sector":
        beta0 = I.par("cd_beta0_allsector", ["cendiv"])
        nat_beta_val = sc["nat_beta_energy"]
    elif sector == "electric_sector":
        beta0 = I.par("cd_beta0", ["cendiv"])
        nat_beta_val = sc["nat_beta_nonenergy"]
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"GSw_GasSector={sector!r} is not electric_sector or energy_sector")
    t_after = t_all.filter(yr("t") > 2010)
    cd_beta = nonzero(semi(beta0, cendiv, ["cendiv"]).join(t_after, how="cross").select(["cendiv", "t", "value"]))
    nat_beta = t_after.with_columns(pl.lit(float(nat_beta_val)).alias("value"))
    S["cd_beta"] = cd_beta
    S["nat_beta"] = nat_beta
    n = fuelbin.height
    width = (sc["normfuelbinmax"] - sc["normfuelbinmin"]) / (n - 2)
    bot = sc["normfuelbinmin"]
    top = sc["topfuelbinwidth"]
    ordf = fuelbin.with_row_index("ord", offset=1).with_columns(pl.col("ord").cast(pl.Float64))
    binmult = pl.when(pl.col("ord") == 1).then(bot).when(pl.col("ord") == n).then(top).otherwise(width)
    qq_frac = bot + (pl.col("ord") - 1) * width - width / 2
    dom_reg = ordf.join(cendiv, how="cross").join(t_all, how="cross")
    reg = (dom_reg.join(supply.rename({"value": "sup"}), on=["cendiv", "t"], how="left")
           .join(cd_beta.rename({"value": "beta"}), on=["cendiv", "t"], how="left")
           .with_columns(pl.col("sup").fill_null(0.0), pl.col("beta").fill_null(0.0)))
    gbw_reg = reg.with_columns((pl.col("sup") * binmult).alias("value"))
    gbw_reg = gbw_reg.with_columns(pl.when(pl.col("value") < 10.0).then(10.0).otherwise(pl.col("value")).alias("value"))
    S["gasbinwidth_regional"] = gbw_reg.select(["fuelbin", "cendiv", "t", "value"])
    gbp_reg = (reg.with_columns((pl.col("sup") * qq_frac).alias("qq"))
               .with_columns(gams_round((pl.col("beta") * (pl.col("qq") - pl.col("sup"))) / 1e9, 5).alias("value")))
    S["gasbinp_regional"] = nonzero(gbp_reg.select(["fuelbin", "cendiv", "t", "value"]))
    dom_nat = ordf.join(t_all, how="cross")
    nat = (dom_nat.join(usage.rename({"value": "use"}), on="t", how="left").join(nat_beta.rename({"value": "beta"}), on="t", how="left")
           .with_columns(pl.col("use").fill_null(0.0), pl.col("beta").fill_null(0.0)))
    S["gasbinwidth_national"] = nonzero(nat.with_columns((pl.col("use") * binmult).alias("value")).select(["fuelbin", "t", "value"]))
    gbp_nat = (nat.with_columns((pl.col("use") * qq_frac).alias("qq"))
               .with_columns(gams_round(pl.col("beta") * (pl.col("qq") - pl.col("use")) / 1e9, 5).alias("value")))
    S["gasbinp_national"] = nonzero(gbp_nat.select(["fuelbin", "t", "value"]))
    alpha = semi(I.par("alpha", ["allt", "cendiv"]).rename({"allt": "t"}), t_all, ["t"])
    lag = t_all.with_columns((yr("t") - 2).cast(pl.Int64).cast(pl.Utf8).alias("tlag"))
    gmt = (cendiv.join(t_all, how="cross").join(lag, on="t", how="inner")
           .join(alpha.rename({"value": "alpha"}), on=["t", "cendiv"], how="left")
           .join(nat_beta.rename({"value": "nb"}), on="t", how="left")
           .join(usage.rename({"value": "use", "t": "tlag"}), on="tlag", how="left")
           .join(cd_beta.rename({"value": "cb"}), on=["cendiv", "t"], how="left")
           .join(supply.rename({"value": "sup", "t": "tlag"}), on=["cendiv", "tlag"], how="left")
           .with_columns([pl.col(c).fill_null(0.0) for c in ["alpha", "nb", "use", "cb", "sup"]])
           .with_columns((pl.col("alpha") + pl.col("nb") * pl.col("use") / 1e9 + pl.col("cb") * pl.col("sup") / 1e9).alias("value")))
    S["gasmultterm"] = nonzero(gmt.select(["cendiv", "t", "value"])).with_columns(gams_round(pl.col("value"), 3).alias("value"))
    weights = semi(I.par("cendivweights", ["r", "cendiv"]), cendiv, ["cendiv"])
    S["cendiv_weights"] = nonzero(weights).with_columns(gams_round(pl.col("value"), 3).alias("value"))
    S["gasmult_r"] = nonzero(fsum_by(S.cendiv_weights.rename({"value": "w"}).join(S.gasmultterm, on="cendiv", how="inner")
                                     .with_columns((pl.col("value") * pl.col("w")).alias("value")).select(["r", "t", "value"]), ["r", "t"]))
    S["slice_objop_VGASBINQ_REGIONAL"] = S.gasbinp_regional.filter(pl.col("t") == year)
    S["slice_objop_VGASBINQ_NATIONAL"] = S.gasbinp_national.filter(pl.col("t") == year)
    return S

pyoframe and polars operations in this code (syntax reference)
  • .rename({...}): rename index columns to line up with the row
  • how="semi": keep rows whose keys are in the other table ($-condition)
  • how="anti": keep rows whose keys are not in the other table
  • how="inner": keep matching rows of both (a missing factor removes the row)
  • how="left": keep every row of the left table (missing values become null, then 0)
  • how="cross": Cartesian product
  • fill_null(0.0): a missing GAMS parameter is 0
  • group_by(keys).agg(...): sum over the indices not in keys
  • pl.concat([...]): stack row sets (union of domains)
  • .unique(): distinct rows, so a domain has no duplicates
  • pl.when(c).then(a).otherwise(b): elementwise conditional (GAMS $ on a value)
Notes
  • ported; no rows in either reference case because routes_inv is empty there (no INVTRAN columns)

GAMS reeds/core/setup/c_model.gms:1988
eq_POI_cap(r,t)
    $[tmodel(t)
    $Sw_TransIntraCost
    $(not Sw_PCM)]..

* The sum of POI capacity...
    poi_cap_init(r)
    + sum{tt$[(yeart(tt)<=yeart(t))$(tmodel(tt) or tfix(tt))], INV_POI(r,tt) }

    =g=

* must be greater than the sum of all generation capacity [AC] without explicit spur lines...
    sum{(i,v)$[valcap(i,v,r,t)$(not spur_techs(i))], CAP(i,v,r,t) / ilr(i) }
* and spur-line capacity if explicitly tracked (use total capacity, not just new investments,
* to make sure we account for the existing spur line capacity already included in poi_cap_init)...
    + sum{x$[xfeas(x)$x_r(x,r)$Sw_SpurScen], CAP_SPUR(x,t) }
* and AC/DC converter capacity for VSC...
    + CAP_CONVERTER(r,t)$val_converter(r,t)
* and LCC (INVTRAN(r,rr) == INVTRAN(rr,r) for DC so only need to add one direction)
    + sum{(rr,tt)$[routes_inv(r,rr,"LCC",t)$(yeart(tt)<=yeart(t))$(tmodel(tt) or tfix(tt))],
          INVTRAN(r,rr,"LCC",tt)
    }
;

if "INV_POI" in P.var:
    poi_dom = P.var["INV_POI"]
    past_poi = (case["state_INV_POI"].join(tfix_tt, on="tt", how="semi").join(tmodel, how="cross")
                .filter(pl.col("tt") <= pl.col("t")).group_by(["r", "t"]).agg(pl.col("value").sum()))
    const = _add(_on_domain(poi_dom, case["poi_cap_init"], ["r"]), past_poi, ["r", "t"])
    lcc_past = (case["state_INVTRAN"].filter(pl.col("trtype") == "lcc").join(case["routes_inv_tfix"], on=["r", "rr", "trtype", "tt"], how="semi")
                .join(rinv_all.filter(pl.col("trtype") == "lcc").select(["r", "rr", "t"]), on=["r", "rr"], how="inner")
                .filter(pl.col("tt") <= pl.col("t")).join(tmodel, on="t", how="semi").group_by(["r", "t"]).agg(pl.col("value").sum()))
    P.coef["poi_const"] = _add(const, lcc_past, ["r", "t"], sign=-1.0)
    P.con["eq_POI_cap"] = poi_dom
    P.coef["poi_inv"] = _signed(poi_dom, ["r", "t"], 1.0)
    cap_rows = _not_in(valcap, "i", S["spur_techs"]).join(case["ilr"].rename({"value": "ilr"}), on="i", how="left")
    if cap_rows.filter(pl.col("ilr").is_null() | (pl.col("ilr") == 0.0)).height:
        raise ValueError("ilr is missing for a technology in valcap (GAMS would divide by zero in eq_POI_cap)")
    P.coef["poi_cap"] = cap_rows.with_columns((-(1.0 / pl.col("ilr"))).alias("value")).select(V4 + ["value"])
    if "CAP_SPUR" in P.var:
        P.coef["poi_spur"] = (case["x_r"].join(case["xfeas"], on="x", how="semi").join(tmodel, how="cross")
                              .select(["r", "x", "t"]).with_columns(pl.lit(-1.0).alias("value")))
    if "INVTRAN" in P.var:
        lcc_now = P.var["INVTRAN"].filter(pl.col("trtype") == "lcc")
        lcc_unfixed_past = (lcc_now.select(["r", "rr", "trtype"]).join(tfix_tt, how="cross")
                            .join(case["routes_inv_tfix"], on=["r", "rr", "trtype", "tt"], how="anti")
                            .rename({"tt": "t"}).select(ROUTE_IDX))
        P.var["INVTRAN"] = pl.concat([P.var["INVTRAN"], lcc_unfixed_past]).unique()
        lcc_rows = case["routes_inv"].filter(pl.col("trtype") == "lcc").join(tmodel, on="t", how="semi").select(["r", "rr", "trtype", "t"])
        lcc_cols = pl.concat([lcc_now, lcc_unfixed_past]).rename({"t": "tt"})
        P.coef["poi_lcc"] = (lcc_cols.join(lcc_rows, on=["r", "rr", "trtype"], how="inner").filter(pl.col("tt") <= pl.col("t"))
                             .with_columns(pl.lit(-1.0).alias("value")).select(["r", "rr", "trtype", "tt", "t", "value"]))

pyoframe and polars operations in this code (syntax reference)
  • .rename({...}): rename index columns to line up with the row
  • how="semi": keep rows whose keys are in the other table ($-condition)
  • how="anti": keep rows whose keys are not in the other table
  • how="inner": keep matching rows of both (a missing factor removes the row)
  • how="left": keep every row of the left table (missing values become null, then 0)
  • how="cross": Cartesian product
  • group_by(keys).agg(...): sum over the indices not in keys
  • pl.concat([...]): stack row sets (union of domains)
  • .unique(): distinct rows, so a domain has no duplicates

prep.py:1006
if int(case.scalar("Sw_PRM_NetImportLimit")):
    rtr = case["routes_transreg"]
    flow_prm = P.var["FLOW"].join(routes_prm, on=["r", "rr"], how="semi").join(_in(h, "h", h_stress), on="h", how="semi")
    imports = (flow_prm.join(rtr.rename({"transreg": "transregg", "transregg": "transreg"}), on=["r", "rr"], how="inner")
               .join(case["tranloss"].rename({"value": "loss"}), on=R3, how="left")
               .with_columns((-(1.0 - pl.col("loss").fill_null(0.0))).alias("value")).select(["transreg"] + FLOW_IDX + ["value"]))
    exports = (flow_prm.join(rtr, on=["r", "rr"], how="inner").with_columns(pl.lit(1.0).alias("value"))
               .select(["transreg"] + FLOW_IDX + ["value"]))
    firm_flow = pl.concat([imports, exports])
    firm_rows = firm_flow.select(["transreg", "h", "t"]).unique()
    lim = case["firm_import_limit"].rename({"value": "lim"})
    peak = case["peakload_transreg"].rename({"value": "peak"})
    P.con["eq_firm_transfer_limit"] = firm_rows
    P.coef["firm_const"] = (firm_rows.join(lim, on=["transreg", "t"], how="left").join(peak, on=["transreg", "t"], how="left")
                            .with_columns((pl.col("lim").fill_null(0.0) * pl.col("peak").fill_null(0.0)).alias("value"))
                            .select(["transreg", "h", "t", "value"]))
    P.coef["firm_flow"] = firm_flow

prep.py:1024
tim_types = int(case.scalar("Sw_TransInvMaxTypes"))
if tim_types and "INVTRAN" in P.var:
    tim = case["trans_inv_max"].join(tmodel, on="t", how="semi")
    prev = case["tprev"].join(tmodel, on="t", how="semi")
    tim_rows = tim.join(prev, on="t", how="inner").with_columns(
        ((pl.col("value") * 1e6) * (pl.col("t") - pl.col("tt")).cast(pl.Float64)).alias("value")).select(["t", "value"])
    P.con["eq_transmission_investment_max"] = tim_rows.select("t")
    P.coef["tim_const"] = tim_rows
    dist = case["distance"].rename({"value": "d"})
    inv = P.var["INVTRAN"].join(tmodel, on="t", how="semi")
    fwd_rows = inv.join(dist, on=R3, how="left").with_columns((-(0.5 * pl.col("d").fill_null(0.0))).alias("value")).select(ROUTE_IDX + ["value"])
    rev_rows = (inv.join(dist, on=R3, how="left").with_columns((-(0.5 * pl.col("d").fill_null(0.0))).alias("value"))
                .select([pl.col("rr").alias("r"), pl.col("r").alias("rr"), "trtype", "t", "value"]))
    P.coef["tim_inv"] = pl.concat([fwd_rows, rev_rows]).group_by(ROUTE_IDX).agg(pl.col("value").sum()).select(ROUTE_IDX + ["value"])
    if tim_types in (2, 3):
        dr = case["distance_reinforcement"].rename({"value": "dr"})
        ds = case["distance_spur"].rename({"value": "ds"})
        rsc_rows = (P.var["INV_RSC"].join(dr, on=["i", "r", "rscbin"], how="left").join(ds, on=["i", "r", "rscbin"], how="left")
                    .with_columns((-(pl.col("dr").fill_null(0.0) + (pl.col("ds").fill_null(0.0) if tim_types == 3 else 0.0))).alias("value"))
                    .select(RSC_IDX + ["value"]))
        P.coef["tim_rsc"] = rsc_rows
    else:
        P.coef["tim_rsc"] = pl.DataFrame(schema={"t": pl.Int64, "i": pl.Utf8, "v": pl.Utf8, "r": pl.Utf8, "rscbin": pl.Utf8, "value": pl.Float64})

CONV = ["r", "h", "intype", "outtype", "t"]
conv_dom = case["val_converter"].join(tmodel, on="t", how="semi").select(["r", "t"])
if int(case.scalar("Sw_VSC")):
    eff_vsc = case.scalar("converter_efficiency_vsc")
    P.var["CAP_CONVERTER"] = conv_dom
    P.var["INV_CONVERTER"] = conv_dom
    directions = pl.DataFrame({"intype": ["ac", "vsc"], "outtype": ["vsc", "ac"]})
    P.var["CONVERSION"] = conv_dom.join(h, how="cross").join(directions, how="cross").select(CONV)
    conv_sign = (P.var["CONVERSION"]
                 .with_columns(pl.when(pl.col("intype") == "vsc").then(eff_vsc).otherwise(-1.0 / eff_vsc).alias("value")))
    P.coef["bal_conv"] = conv_sign
    vsc_flow = P.var["FLOW"].filter(pl.col("trtype") == "vsc")
    P.coef["vsc_import"] = (vsc_flow.join(case["tranloss"], on=["r", "rr", "trtype"], how="left")
                            .with_columns((1.0 - pl.col("value").fill_null(0.0)).alias("value"))
                            .rename({"r": "rr", "rr": "r"}).select(FLOW_IDX + ["value"]))
    P.coef["vsc_export"] = _signed(vsc_flow, FLOW_IDX, -1.0)
    P.coef["vsc_conv"] = (P.var["CONVERSION"]
                          .with_columns(pl.when(pl.col("intype") == "ac").then(eff_vsc).otherwise(-1.0 / eff_vsc).alias("value")))
    P.coef["vsc_offgen"] = _signed(_in(P.var["GEN"], "r", case.members("offshore")), GEN_IDX, 1.0)
    P.con["eq_vsc_flow"] = pl.concat([
        P.coef["vsc_import"].select(["r", "h", "t"]), P.coef["vsc_export"].select(["r", "h", "t"]),
        P.coef["vsc_conv"].select(["r", "h", "t"]), P.coef["vsc_offgen"].select(["r", "h", "t"]),
    ]).unique()
    val_conv_fixed = case["val_converter"].join(tfix, on="t", how="semi").select(["r", pl.col("t").alias("tt")])
    past_conv = (case["state_INV_CONVERTER"].join(val_conv_fixed, on=["r", "tt"], how="semi").join(tmodel, how="cross")
                 .filter(pl.col("tt") <= pl.col("t")).group_by(["r", "t"]).agg(pl.col("value").sum()))
    P.con["eq_CAP_CONVERTER"] = conv_dom
    P.coef["capconv_const"] = _on_domain(conv_dom, past_conv, ["r", "t"]).with_columns((-pl.col("value")).alias("value"))
    P.coef["capconv_cap"] = _signed(conv_dom, ["r", "t"], 1.0)
    val_conv_tfix = case["val_converter"].join(tfix, on="t", how="semi").select(["r", "t"])
    conv_unfixed_past = (conv_dom.select("r").unique().join(tfix, how="cross")
                         .join(val_conv_tfix, on=["r", "t"], how="anti").select(["r", "t"]))
    P.var["INV_CONVERTER"] = pl.concat([conv_dom, conv_unfixed_past]).unique()
    conv_cols = P.var["INV_CONVERTER"].rename({"t": "tt"})
    P.coef["capconv_inv"] = (conv_cols.join(conv_dom, on="r", how="inner").filter(pl.col("tt") <= pl.col("t"))
                             .with_columns(pl.lit(-1.0).alias("value")).select(["r", "tt", "t", "value"]))
    P.con["eq_CONVERSION_limit_energy"] = conv_dom.join(h, how="cross").select(["r", "h", "t"])
    P.coef["convlim_cap"] = _signed(P.con["eq_CONVERSION_limit_energy"], ["r", "h", "t"], 1.0)
    P.coef["convlim_conv"] = _signed(P.var["CONVERSION"], CONV, -1.0)
    conv_max = case.scalar("Sw_VSC_ConverterMax")
    if conv_max:
        P.con["eq_converter_max"] = conv_dom
        P.coef["convmax_const"] = conv_dom.with_columns(pl.lit(float(conv_max)).alias("value"))
        P.coef["convmax_cap"] = _signed(conv_dom, ["r", "t"], -1.0)
P.coef["poi_conv"] = _signed(conv_dom if "CAP_CONVERTER" in P.var else conv_dom.head(0), ["r", "t"], -1.0)

rhs = −K[capconv_const] joined onto the rows (0 where the constant table has no row). Each (row, column) pair is summed before packing, zero coefficients are dropped, and the column label is the variable's position in its prep domain.

Helpers in this code: _in, _on_domain, _signed, _term_entries, _add_row

pyoframe and polars operations in this code (syntax reference)
  • .rename({...}): rename index columns to line up with the row
  • how="semi": keep rows whose keys are in the other table ($-condition)
  • how="anti": keep rows whose keys are not in the other table
  • how="inner": keep matching rows of both (a missing factor removes the row)
  • how="left": keep every row of the left table (missing values become null, then 0)
  • how="cross": Cartesian product
  • fill_null(0.0): a missing GAMS parameter is 0
  • group_by(keys).agg(...): sum over the indices not in keys
  • pl.concat([...]): stack row sets (union of domains)
  • .unique(): distinct rows, so a domain has no duplicates
  • pl.when(c).then(a).otherwise(b): elementwise conditional (GAMS $ on a value)
Notes
  • No rows in the Pacific cases (no VSC routes). Validated on the WECC_oracle case in 2035 (4 rows): GAMS sums INV_CONVERTER over every past year, while 5_varfix.gms fixes it only where val_converter held in that year, so the 2010–2030 columns (18 here) are free and carry no cost in the 2035 solve. GAMS used them to place its converters; the port adds the same columns (prep: conv_unfixed_past) and keeps their levels out of capconv_const.

eq_vsc_flow(r,h,t)
    $[tmodel(t)
    $Sw_VSC]..

* [plus] net VSC DC transmission with imports reduced by losses
    + sum{rr$routes(rr,r,"VSC",t), (1-tranloss(rr,r,"VSC")) * FLOW(rr,r,h,t,"VSC") }
    - sum{rr$routes(r,rr,"VSC",t), FLOW(r,rr,h,t,"VSC") }

* [plus] net VSC AC/DC conversion
    + (CONVERSION(r,h,"AC","VSC",t) * converter_efficiency_vsc)$val_converter(r,t)
    - (CONVERSION(r,h,"VSC","AC",t) / converter_efficiency_vsc)$val_converter(r,t)

* [plus] generation in offshore nodes/zones, which are assumed to use DC
* (Eventually it would be better to add an "energy carrier" index to directly represent
* DC generation.)
    + sum{(i,v)$[valgen(i,v,r,t)$offshore(r)], GEN(i,v,r,h,t) }

    =e=

* no direct consumption of DC power
    0

if int(case.scalar("Sw_StateCap")):
    sc_states = case["co2_state_cap"].select("st").unique()
    sc_rows = (sc_states.join(tmodel, how="cross").filter(pl.col("t") >= case.scalar("state_cap_start_yr")))
    emit_st = emit_co2.join(case["r_st"], on="r", how="inner").join(sc_rows, on=["st", "t"], how="semi")
    cap_on = int(case.scalar("Sw_AnnualCap")) > 0
    emit_cap_t = case["emit_cap"].filter(pl.col("eall").is_in(["co2", "co2e"])).select("t").unique()
    flow_rows = (P.var["FLOW"].join(_in(h, "h", h_rep), on="h", how="semi")
                 .join(case["r_st"].rename({"st": "st_from"}), on="r", how="left")
                 .join(case["r_st"].rename({"r": "rr"}), on="rr", how="inner").join(sc_rows, on=["st", "t"], how="semi")
                 .filter(pl.col("st_from").is_null() | (pl.col("st_from") != pl.col("st"))))
    if cap_on:
        flow_rows = flow_rows.join(emit_cap_t, on="t", how="semi")
    rate = (case["state_co2_emit_rate_r"].rename({"value": "rate"})
            .join(case["tprev"].join(tmodel, on="t", how="semi"), on="tt", how="inner").select(["r", "t", "rate"]))
    stcap_flow = (flow_rows.join(hours.rename({"value": "hrs"}), on="h", how="inner").join(rate, on=["r", "t"], how="left")
                  .with_columns((-(pl.col("hrs") * pl.col("rate").fill_null(0.0))).alias("value"))
                  .select(["st"] + FLOW_IDX + ["value"]).filter(pl.col("value") != 0.0))
    rows = pl.concat([emit_st.select(["st", "t"]), stcap_flow.select(["st", "t"])]).unique()
    P.con["eq_state_cap"] = rows
    P.coef["stcap_const"] = _on_domain(rows, case["co2_state_cap"], ["st", "t"])
    P.coef["stcap_emit"] = _signed(emit_st, ["st", "etype", "e", "r", "t"], -1.0)
    P.coef["stcap_flow"] = stcap_flow

pyoframe and polars operations in this code (syntax reference)
  • .rename({...}): rename index columns to line up with the row
  • how="semi": keep rows whose keys are in the other table ($-condition)
  • how="inner": keep matching rows of both (a missing factor removes the row)
  • how="left": keep every row of the left table (missing values become null, then 0)
  • how="cross": Cartesian product
  • fill_null(0.0): a missing GAMS parameter is 0
  • pl.concat([...]): stack row sets (union of domains)
  • .unique(): distinct rows, so a domain has no duplicates

if int(case.scalar("Sw_CSAPR")):
    nox = (case["emit_rate"].filter((pl.col("etype") == "process") & (pl.col("e") == "nox")).select(V4 + [pl.col("value").alias("er")])
           .join(valgen, on=V4, how="semi"))
    hw = case["h_weight_csapr"].rename({"value": "hw"})
    gen_nox = (nox.join(hours_rep.rename({"value": "hrs"}), how="cross").join(hw, on="h", how="inner")
               .join(case["r_st"], on="r", how="inner")
               .with_columns((-((pl.col("hw") * pl.col("hrs")) * pl.col("er"))).alias("value")))
    start = case.scalar("csapr_startyr")
    ccap = case["csapr_cap"].join(tmodel, on="t", how="semi").filter(pl.col("t") >= start)
    grp = case["csapr_group_st"]
    if grp.height:
        budget = (ccap.filter(pl.col("csapr_cat") == "budget").join(grp, on="st", how="inner").join(case["stfeas"], on="st", how="semi")
                  .group_by(["csapr_group", "t"]).agg(pl.col("value").sum()))
        csb_gen = gen_nox.join(grp, on="st", how="inner").select(["csapr_group"] + GEN_IDX + ["value"])
        rows = grp.select("csapr_group").unique().join(tmodel, how="cross").filter(pl.col("t") >= start)
        rows = rows.join(csb_gen.select(["csapr_group", "t"]).unique(), on=["csapr_group", "t"], how="semi")
        P.con["eq_CSAPR_Budget"] = rows
        P.coef["csb_const"] = _on_domain(rows, budget, ["csapr_group", "t"])
        P.coef["csb_gen"] = csb_gen
    assure = ccap.filter(pl.col("csapr_cat") == "assurance").join(case["stfeas"], on="st", how="semi").select(["st", "t", "value"])
    csa_gen = gen_nox.join(assure.select(["st", "t"]), on=["st", "t"], how="semi").select(["st"] + GEN_IDX + ["value"])
    rows = assure.join(csa_gen.select(["st", "t"]).unique(), on=["st", "t"], how="semi")
    P.con["eq_CSAPR_Assurance"] = rows.select(["st", "t"])
    P.coef["csa_const"] = rows
    P.coef["csa_gen"] = csa_gen

        hours(h) * GEN(i,v,r,h,t) * sum{e, (emit_rate("process",e,i,v,r,t) + emit_rate("upstream",e,i,v,r,t)$Sw_Upstream) * gwp(e) } }

*hydro is the only technology adjusted by RPSTechMult

*because GEN from pvb(i) includes grid charging, subtract out its grid charging
    + sum{(v,r,h)$[valgen(i,v,r,t)$r_st(r,st)$h_rep(h)],

rhs = 0. Each (row, column) pair is summed before packing, zero coefficients are dropped, and the column label is the variable's position in its prep domain.

Helpers in this code: _term_entries, _add_row

pyoframe and polars operations in this code (syntax reference)
  • .rename({...}): rename index columns to line up with the row
  • how="semi": keep rows whose keys are in the other table ($-condition)
  • how="anti": keep rows whose keys are not in the other table
  • how="inner": keep matching rows of both (a missing factor removes the row)
  • how="left": keep every row of the left table (missing values become null, then 0)
  • fill_null(0.0): a missing GAMS parameter is 0
  • pl.concat([...]): stack row sets (union of domains)
  • .unique(): distinct rows, so a domain has no duplicates
Notes
  • The RECS variable is indexed (rpscat, i, st, ast, t); in the row tables its category and selling state are renamed rpscat_v and st_v so they do not collide with the row's own rpscat and st.

distpv_gen = _in(P.var["GEN"], "i", S["distpv"])

def load_terms(rows, region_map, ces_exports):
    rr = rows.join(style, on=["st", "rpscat"], how="left").with_columns(pl.col("style").fill_null(0.0))
    reg = rr.join(region_map, on="st", how="inner").join(hours_rep.rename({"value": "hrs"}), how="cross")
    f01 = pl.when(pl.col("style") == 0.0).then((1.0 - dl) * pl.col("hrs")).when(pl.col("style") == 1.0).then(pl.col("hrs")).otherwise(None)
    load = (reg.filter(pl.col("style") < 2.0).with_columns((-(f01 * pl.col("mult"))).alias("value"))
            .select(RQ + ["r", "h", "value"]))
    gen_d = (reg.filter(pl.col("style") < 2.0).join(distpv_gen, on=["r", "h", "t"], how="inner")
             .with_columns((f01 * pl.col("mult")).alias("value")).select(RQ + ["i", "v", "r", "h", "value"]))
    gen2 = (reg.filter(pl.col("style") == 2.0).join(_not_in(P.var["GEN"], "i", S["storage_standalone"]), on=["r", "h", "t"], how="inner")
            .with_columns((-((pl.when(pl.col("i").is_in(list(S["distpv"]))).then(1.0 + (-dl)).otherwise(1.0) * pl.col("hrs")) * pl.col("mult"))).alias("value"))
            .select(RQ + ["i", "v", "r", "h", "value"]))
    c = (reg.join(ce, on=["r", "h", "t"], how="inner")
         .with_columns(pl.when(pl.col("style") == 0.0).then(((pl.col("ce") * (1.0 - dl)) * pl.col("hrs")) * pl.col("mult"))
                       .when(pl.col("style") == 1.0).then((pl.col("ce") * pl.col("hrs")) * pl.col("mult"))
                       .otherwise(pl.when(pl.col("rpscat") == "ces").then((pl.col("ce") * pl.col("hrs")) * pl.col("mult")).otherwise(0.0) if ces_exports else 0.0).alias("value"))
         .group_by(RQ).agg(pl.col("value").sum()))
    return c, load, pl.concat([gen_d, gen2])

req_rows = req_dom.select(RQ)

const, load_c, gen_c = load_terms(req_dom.rename({"value": "mult"}), rr_map, True)
exp_c = (req_rows.filter(pl.col("rpscat") == "ces").join(case["r_st"], on="st", how="inner").join(hours_rep.rename({"value": "hrs"}), how="cross")
         .join(ce, on=["r", "h", "t"], how="inner").with_columns((-(pl.col("ce") * pl.col("hrs"))).alias("value")).group_by(RQ).agg(pl.col("value").sum()))
P.con["eq_REC_Requirement"] = req_rows

P.coef["recreq_load"] = load_c
P.coef["recreq_gen"] = gen_c
def into(rows, sign, strict):
    base = recs_dom.join(stfeas, on="st", how="semi").with_columns(pl.col("ast").alias("st_row"))
    if strict:
        base = base.filter(pl.col("st") != pl.col("ast"))
    return base.join(rows.rename({"st": "st_row"}).select(["rpscat", "st_row", "t"]), on=["rpscat", "st_row", "t"], how="semi").with_columns(pl.lit(float(sign)).alias("value"))

def outof(rows, sign, allow_voluntary):
    dest = st_or_vol if allow_voluntary else stfeas
    base = (recs_dom.filter(pl.col("st") != pl.col("ast")).join(dest.rename({"st": "ast"}), on="ast", how="semi")
            .with_columns(pl.col("st").alias("st_row")))
    return base.join(rows.rename({"st": "st_row"}).select(["rpscat", "st_row", "t"]), on=["rpscat", "st_row", "t"], how="semi").with_columns(pl.lit(float(sign)).alias("value"))

imp = into(req_rows, 1.0, False)
exp = outof(req_rows, -1.0, False)

def bundled_terms(rows_cat, cat_b, sign, direction):
    base = recs_dom.filter((pl.col("rpscat") == cat_b) & (pl.col("st") != pl.col("ast"))).join(stfeas.rename({"st": "ast"}), on="ast", how="semi")
    if direction == "in":
        base = base.join(stfeas, on="st", how="semi")
        keyed = base.with_columns(pl.col("ast").alias("st_row"))
    else:
        keyed = base.with_columns(pl.col("st").alias("st_row"))
    keyed = keyed.join(rows_cat.rename({"st": "st_row"}).select(["st_row", "t"]), on=["st_row", "t"], how="semi")
    return keyed.with_columns(pl.lit(float(sign)).alias("value"))

def recs_coef(parts, row_cat_col):
    out = []
    for p, rowcat in parts:
        out.append(p.select([pl.lit(rowcat).alias("rpscat_row") if rowcat else pl.col("rpscat").alias("rpscat_row"),
                             pl.col("st_row") if "st_row" in p.columns else pl.col("st").alias("st_row"), "t",
                             pl.col("rpscat").alias("rpscat_v"), "i", "st", "ast", "value"]))
    return pl.concat(out)

req_all = req_rows.filter(pl.col("rpscat") == "rps_all")
req_ces = req_rows.filter(pl.col("rpscat") == "ces")
rq_parts = [(imp, None), (exp, None),
            (bundled_terms(req_all, "rps_bundled", 1.0, "in"), "rps_all"), (bundled_terms(req_all, "rps_bundled", -1.0, "out"), "rps_all"),
            (bundled_terms(req_ces, "ces_bundled", 1.0, "in"), "ces"), (bundled_terms(req_ces, "ces_bundled", -1.0, "out"), "ces")]
P.coef["recreq_recs"] = recs_coef(rq_parts, None).rename({"rpscat_row": "rpscat", "st_row": "st_r"}).select(
    ["rpscat", pl.col("st_r").alias("st"), "t", "rpscat_v", "i", pl.col("st").alias("st_v"), "ast", "value"])
acp_rows = req_rows.join(case["acp_disallowed"].select(["st", "rpscat"]), on=["st", "rpscat"], how="anti")
P.coef["recreq_acp"] = _signed(acp_rows, RQ, 1.0)

pyoframe and polars operations in this code (syntax reference)
  • .rename({...}): rename index columns to line up with the row
  • how="semi": keep rows whose keys are in the other table ($-condition)
  • how="anti": keep rows whose keys are not in the other table
  • how="inner": keep matching rows of both (a missing factor removes the row)
  • how="left": keep every row of the left table (missing values become null, then 0)
  • how="cross": Cartesian product
  • fill_null(0.0): a missing GAMS parameter is 0
  • group_by(keys).agg(...): sum over the indices not in keys
  • pl.concat([...]): stack row sets (union of domains)
  • pl.when(c).then(a).otherwise(b): elementwise conditional (GAMS $ on a value)
Notes
  • The GAMS RecStyle selector is evaluated per (st, RPSCat); load_terms joins recstyle on exactly those keys.

if ofs_rows.height:
    exog = (_in(case["m_capacity_exog"], "i", S["ofswind"]).join(case["r_st"], on="r", how="inner").group_by(["st", "t"]).agg(pl.col("value").sum()))
    cond = case["inv_cond"].join(_in(valcap, "i", S["ofswind"]).select(V4), on=V4, how="semi").join(case["r_st"], on="r", how="inner")
    cur_inv = (cond.join(tmodel_tt, on="tt", how="semi").join(P.var["INV"].rename({"t": "tt"}), on=["i", "v", "r", "tt"], how="semi")
               .select(["st", "t", "i", "v", "r", "tt"]).with_columns(pl.lit(1.0).alias("value")))
    past = (cond.join(tfix_tt, on="tt", how="semi").join(case["state_INV"], on=["i", "v", "r", "tt"], how="inner").group_by(["st", "t"]).agg(pl.col("value").sum()))
    if "INV_REFURB" in P.var:
        cur_ref = (cond.join(tmodel_tt, on="tt", how="semi").join(P.var["INV_REFURB"].rename({"t": "tt"}), on=["i", "v", "r", "tt"], how="semi")
                   .select(["st", "t", "i", "v", "r", "tt"]).with_columns(pl.lit(1.0).alias("value")))
        past_ref = (cond.join(tfix_tt, on="tt", how="semi").join(case["state_INV_REFURB"], on=["i", "v", "r", "tt"], how="inner")
                    .join(_in(valcap.select("i").unique(), "i", refurb), on="i", how="semi").group_by(["st", "t"]).agg(pl.col("value").sum()))
    else:
        cur_ref = cur_inv.head(0)
        past_ref = past.head(0)
    const = _add(_add(_on_domain(ofs_rows.select(["st", "t"]), exog, ["st", "t"]), past, ["st", "t"]), past_ref, ["st", "t"])
    cur_inv = cur_inv.join(ofs_rows.select(["st", "t"]), on=["st", "t"], how="semi")
    cur_ref = cur_ref.join(ofs_rows.select(["st", "t"]), on=["st", "t"], how="semi")
    with_vars = pl.concat([cur_inv.select(["st", "t"]), cur_ref.select(["st", "t"])]).unique()
    P.con["eq_RPS_OFSWind"] = ofs_rows.select(["st", "t"]).join(with_vars, on=["st", "t"], how="semi")
    P.coef["ofs_const"] = _add(const, ofs_rows.select(["st", "t", "value"]), ["st", "t"], sign=-1.0).join(with_vars, on=["st", "t"], how="semi")
    P.coef["ofs_inv"] = cur_inv
    P.coef["ofs_refurb"] = cur_ref

        tgi = case["tg_i"]
        q_rows = (tgi.select("tg").unique().join(case["r"], how="cross").join(tmodel, how="cross").filter(pl.col("t") >= mbs))
        has_inv = _in(valinv, "v", S["newv"]).join(tgi, on="i", how="inner").select(["tg", "r", "t"]).unique()
        q_rows = q_rows.join(has_inv, on=["tg", "r", "t"], how="semi").select(["tg", "r", "t"])
        cur_inv = (P.var["INV"].filter(pl.col("v").is_in(list(S["newv"])) & (pl.col("t") >= istart)).join(tgi, on="i", how="inner")
                   .join(q_rows, on=["tg", "r", "t"], how="semi").with_columns(pl.lit(-1.0).alias("value")).select(["tg"] + V4 + ["value"]))
        past = (case["state_INV"].join(tfix_tt, on="tt", how="semi").join(valinv_tfix, on=["i", "v", "r", "tt"], how="semi")
                .filter(pl.col("v").is_in(list(S["newv"])) & (pl.col("tt") >= istart)).join(tgi, on="i", how="inner")
                .join(tmodel, how="cross").group_by(["tg", "r", "t"]).agg(pl.col("value").sum()))
        if "INV_REFURB" in P.var:
            cur_ref = (P.var["INV_REFURB"].filter(pl.col("v").is_in(list(S["newv"])) & (pl.col("t") >= istart)).join(tgi, on="i", how="inner")
                       .join(q_rows, on=["tg", "r", "t"], how="semi").with_columns(pl.lit(-1.0).alias("value")).select(["tg"] + V4 + ["value"]))
            past_ref = (case["state_INV_REFURB"].join(tfix_tt, on="tt", how="semi").join(valinv_tfix, on=["i", "v", "r", "tt"], how="semi")
                        .filter(pl.col("v").is_in(list(S["newv"])) & (pl.col("tt") >= istart)).join(tgi, on="i", how="inner")
                        .join(_in(valcap.select("i").unique(), "i", refurb), on="i", how="semi")
                        .join(tmodel, how="cross").group_by(["tg", "r", "t"]).agg(pl.col("value").sum()))
        else:
            cur_ref = cur_inv.head(0)
            past_ref = past.head(0)
        const = _add(_add(_on_domain(q_rows, ql, ["tg", "r", "t"]), past, ["tg", "r", "t"], sign=-1.0), past_ref, ["tg", "r", "t"], sign=-1.0)
        P.con["eq_interconnection_queues"] = q_rows
        P.coef["queue_const"] = const
        P.coef["queue_above"] = _signed(q_rows, ["tg", "r", "t"], 1.0)
        P.coef["queue_inv"] = cur_inv
        P.coef["queue_refurb"] = cur_ref
        P.var["CAP_ABOVE_LIM"] = pl.concat([q_rows, P.var["CAP_ABOVE_LIM"]]).unique()

derive_ops.py:511
def growth(S: Symbols, state: dict[str, pl.DataFrame] | None) -> Symbols:
    I = S._inputs
    sw = S.sw
    year = str(S.year)
    yint = int(S.year)
    years = S.years
    GB = ["gbin", "st", "tg", "t"]
    ST3 = ["st", "tg", "t"]
    gbin = I.set("gbin", ["gbin"])
    S["gbin"] = gbin
    S["growth_penalty"] = I.par("growth_penalty", ["gbin"])
    gbin_min = I.par("gbin_min", ["tg"])
    S["gbin_min"] = gbin_min
    size_mult = I.par("growth_bin_size_mult", ["gbin"])
    S["growth_bin_size_mult"] = size_mult
    mult1 = float(size_mult.filter(pl.col("gbin") == "gbin1")["value"][0])
    stfeas = S.stfeas
    tg = S.tg
    S["valinv_tg"] = (S.valinv_irt.join(S.r_st, on="r", how="inner").join(S.tg_i, on="i", how="inner").select(ST3).unique())
    on = int(sw["Sw_GrowthPenalties"]) != 0
    first = yint == years[0]
    init = (gbin.join(stfeas, how="cross").join(gbin_min, how="cross")
            .with_columns(pl.lit(year).alias("t")).select(GB + ["value"]))
    S["last_year_max_growth"] = _empty(ST3)
    if first or not on:
        S["growth_bin_limit"] = nonzero(init) if first else _empty(GB)
    else:
        if state is None:
            raise ValueError("growth bin limits for a year after the first need the prior-year investment levels (state)")
        prev_y = max(y for y in years if y < yint)
        earlier = [y for y in years if y < prev_y]
        prev2_y = max(earlier) if earlier else 0
        inv_prev = state["state_INV"].filter(pl.col("tt") == str(prev_y))
        valinv_prev = S.valinv.filter(pl.col("t") == str(prev_y)).rename({"t": "tt"})
        numer = (inv_prev.join(valinv_prev, on=["i", "v", "r", "tt"], how="semi").join(S.r_st, on="r", how="inner")
                 .join(S.tg_i, on="i", how="inner").group_by(["st", "tg"]).agg(pl.col("value").sum().alias("num")))
        allt = sorted(int(x) for x in S.allt["allt"].to_list())
        denom = 0.0
        for a in allt:
            if prev2_y < a <= prev_y:
                denom = denom + mult1 ** (a - prev2_y - 1)
        comp = mult1 ** ((prev_y - prev2_y) - 1)
        lymg = numer.with_columns(((pl.col("num") / denom) * comp).alias("value")).select(["st", "tg", "value"])
        S["last_year_max_growth"] = nonzero(lymg.with_columns(pl.lit(year).alias("t")).select(ST3 + ["value"]))
        gap = yint - prev_y
        growth_sum = pl.lit(0.0)
        for a in allt:
            if prev_y < a <= yint:
                growth_sum = growth_sum + pl.col("value") * (mult1 ** (a - prev_y))
        current = lymg.with_columns((growth_sum / gap).alias("value"))
        prior = state["state_growth_bin_limit"].filter(pl.col("gbin") == "gbin1").select(["st", "tg", "value"])
        init1 = init.filter(pl.col("gbin") == "gbin1").select(["st", "tg", "value"])
        domain = stfeas.join(tg, how="cross").with_columns(pl.lit(0.0).alias("value"))
        best = (pl.concat([domain, current, prior, init1]).group_by(["st", "tg"]).agg(pl.col("value").max()))
        floored = (best.join(gbin_min.rename({"value": "gm"}), on="tg", how="left")
                   .with_columns(pl.when(pl.col("value") < pl.col("gm").fill_null(0.0)).then(pl.col("gm")).otherwise(pl.col("value")).alias("value"))
                   .select(["st", "tg", "value"]))
        bin1 = floored.with_columns(pl.lit("gbin1").alias("gbin"))
        others = (floored.join(size_mult.filter(pl.col("gbin") != "gbin1").rename({"value": "m"}), how="cross")
                  .with_columns((pl.col("value") * (pl.col("m") - mult1)).alias("value")))
        gbl = pl.concat([bin1.select(["gbin", "st", "tg", "value"]), others.select(["gbin", "st", "tg", "value"])])
        gbl = nonzero(gbl).with_columns(gams_round(pl.col("value"), 0).alias("value"), pl.lit(year).alias("t")).select(GB + ["value"])
        S["growth_bin_limit"] = nonzero(gbl)

    IST = ["i", "st", "t"]
    vir = (S.valinv_irt.filter(pl.col("t") == year).join(S.r_st, on="r", how="inner").join(stfeas, on="st", how="semi"))
    if on:
        ccfm = S.cost_cap_fin_mult.filter(pl.col("t") == year).rename({"value": "fin"})
        cc = S.cost_cap.filter(pl.col("t") == year).rename({"value": "cc"})
        scc = members(S.sccapcosttech)
        plain = vir.filter(~isin("i", scc))
        cg_plain = (plain.join(ccfm, on=["i", "r", "t"], how="inner").join(cc, on=["i", "t"], how="inner")
                    .with_columns((pl.col("fin") * pl.col("cc")).alias("value")).group_by(IST).agg(pl.col("value").min()))
        rfm = S.rsc_fin_mult.filter(pl.col("t") == year).rename({"value": "rfm"})
        cost = S.m_rsc_dat.filter(pl.col("sc_cat") == "cost").select(["r", "i", "rscbin", pl.col("value").alias("cost")])
        sc_rows = vir.filter(isin("i", scc))
        cg_sc = (sc_rows.join(rfm, on=["i", "r", "t"], how="inner").join(S.rscbin, how="cross")
                 .join(cost, on=["r", "i", "rscbin"], how="left")
                 .with_columns((pl.col("rfm") * pl.col("cost").fill_null(0.0)).alias("value")).group_by(IST).agg(pl.col("value").min()))
        cg = pl.concat([cg_plain, cg_sc])
        missing = anti(vir.select(IST).unique(), cg, IST)
        if missing.height:
            raise ValueError(f"cost_growth is undefined (GAMS smin over an empty set) for {missing.head(5).rows()}")
        S["cost_growth"] = nonzero(cg.with_columns(gams_round(pl.col("value"), 3).alias("value")))
    else:
        S["cost_growth"] = _empty(IST)
    prev = [y for y in years if y < yint]
    gap_obj = yint - (max(prev) if prev else 0)
    last = float(sw["Sw_GrowthPenLastYear"])
    mbs = float(S.model_builds_start_yr)
    coef = (vir.select(IST).unique().join(gbin, how="cross")
            .join(S.cost_growth.rename({"value": "cg"}), on=IST, how="inner")
            .join(S.growth_penalty.rename({"value": "gp"}), on="gbin", how="inner")
            .with_columns((pl.col("cg") * pl.col("gp") * float(gap_obj)).alias("value")).select(GB[:1] + IST + ["value"]))
    if not (on and mbs <= yint <= last):
        coef = coef.head(0)
    S["slice_objinv_GROWTH_BIN"] = nonzero(coef)
    return S

pyoframe and polars operations in this code (syntax reference)
  • .rename({...}): rename index columns to line up with the row
  • how="semi": keep rows whose keys are in the other table ($-condition)
  • how="inner": keep matching rows of both (a missing factor removes the row)
  • how="left": keep every row of the left table (missing values become null, then 0)
  • how="cross": Cartesian product
  • fill_null(0.0): a missing GAMS parameter is 0
  • group_by(keys).agg(...): sum over the indices not in keys
  • pl.concat([...]): stack row sets (union of domains)
  • .unique(): distinct rows, so a domain has no duplicates
  • pl.when(c).then(a).otherwise(b): elementwise conditional (GAMS $ on a value)
Notes
  • Objective: cost_growth(i,st,t) × growth_penalty(gbin) × gap on GROWTH_BIN, under pvf_capital (slice_objinv_GROWTH_BIN in derive_ops.growth).
  • No rows in either reference case (Sw_GrowthPenalties=0). First exercised by the Pacific_mid test case, where the equation exists only in 2030: model_builds_start_yr is 2026 and Sw_GrowthPenLastYear is 2034.

--MW-- capacity limit for each growth bin

group: policy · v20261010_Pacific_full (pyoframe): 0 rows · v20261009_Pacific_slice (pyoframe): 0 rows · r2_Pacific_mid (pyoframe): 112 rows · r2_Pacific_mid (linopy): 112 rows · r3_WECC_oracle (pyoframe): 0 rows · GAMS source: reeds/core/setup/c_model.gms:1075

Capacity in each growth bin of a technology group and state is limited by the bin size derived from the previous solve year's builds.

\(\displaystyle \P{growth\_bin\_limit}_{gbin,st,tg,t}\)\(\displaystyle \ge\; \sum_{i:\ \mathrm{tg\_i}(tg,i)}\V{GROWTH\_BIN}_{gbin,i,st,t}\)rows\(\mathrm{valinv\_tg}(st,tg,t),\ \mathrm{stfeas}(st),\ \mathrm{Sw\_GrowthPenalties},\ \P{model\_builds\_start\_yr}\le t\le\mathrm{Sw\_GrowthPenLastYear}\)
Where
  • growth_bin_limit (derive_ops.growth) follows 3_solve_oneyear.gms: in the first solve year every bin is gbin_min(tg); afterwards last_year_max_growth = INV at tprev / Σ_{allt} 1.3^{allt-t^{--}-1} × 1.3^{t^- - t^{--} - 1}, gbin1 = Σ_{allt in (t^-, t]} lymg·1.3^{allt-t^-} / (t−t^-), then the running maximum over all solved years (state_growth_bin_limit), floored at gbin_min, the other bins = gbin1 × (growth_bin_size_mult − 1.3), rounded to 0 decimals.
  • valinv_tg(st,tg,t): some (i, r) with valinv_irt(i,r,t), r in st and i in tg.

    S["last_year_max_growth"] = _empty(ST3)
    if first or not on:
        S["growth_bin_limit"] = nonzero(init) if first else _empty(GB)
    else:
        if state is None:
            raise ValueError("growth bin limits for a year after the first need the prior-year investment levels (state)")
        prev_y = max(y for y in years if y < yint)
        earlier = [y for y in years if y < prev_y]
        prev2_y = max(earlier) if earlier else 0
        inv_prev = state["state_INV"].filter(pl.col("tt") == str(prev_y))
        valinv_prev = S.valinv.filter(pl.col("t") == str(prev_y)).rename({"t": "tt"})
        numer = (inv_prev.join(valinv_prev, on=["i", "v", "r", "tt"], how="semi").join(S.r_st, on="r", how="inner")
                 .join(S.tg_i, on="i", how="inner").group_by(["st", "tg"]).agg(pl.col("value").sum().alias("num")))
        allt = sorted(int(x) for x in S.allt["allt"].to_list())
        denom = 0.0
        for a in allt:
            if prev2_y < a <= prev_y:
                denom = denom + mult1 ** (a - prev2_y - 1)
        comp = mult1 ** ((prev_y - prev2_y) - 1)
        lymg = numer.with_columns(((pl.col("num") / denom) * comp).alias("value")).select(["st", "tg", "value"])
        S["last_year_max_growth"] = nonzero(lymg.with_columns(pl.lit(year).alias("t")).select(ST3 + ["value"]))
        gap = yint - prev_y
        growth_sum = pl.lit(0.0)
        for a in allt:
            if prev_y < a <= yint:
                growth_sum = growth_sum + pl.col("value") * (mult1 ** (a - prev_y))
        current = lymg.with_columns((growth_sum / gap).alias("value"))
        prior = state["state_growth_bin_limit"].filter(pl.col("gbin") == "gbin1").select(["st", "tg", "value"])
        init1 = init.filter(pl.col("gbin") == "gbin1").select(["st", "tg", "value"])
        domain = stfeas.join(tg, how="cross").with_columns(pl.lit(0.0).alias("value"))
        best = (pl.concat([domain, current, prior, init1]).group_by(["st", "tg"]).agg(pl.col("value").max()))
        floored = (best.join(gbin_min.rename({"value": "gm"}), on="tg", how="left")
                   .with_columns(pl.when(pl.col("value") < pl.col("gm").fill_null(0.0)).then(pl.col("gm")).otherwise(pl.col("value")).alias("value"))
                   .select(["st", "tg", "value"]))
        bin1 = floored.with_columns(pl.lit("gbin1").alias("gbin"))
        others = (floored.join(size_mult.filter(pl.col("gbin") != "gbin1").rename({"value": "m"}), how="cross")
                  .with_columns((pl.col("value") * (pl.col("m") - mult1)).alias("value")))
        gbl = pl.concat([bin1.select(["gbin", "st", "tg", "value"]), others.select(["gbin", "st", "tg", "value"])])
        gbl = nonzero(gbl).with_columns(gams_round(pl.col("value"), 0).alias("value"), pl.lit(year).alias("t")).select(GB + ["value"])
        S["growth_bin_limit"] = nonzero(gbl)

    IST = ["i", "st", "t"]
    vir = (S.valinv_irt.filter(pl.col("t") == year).join(S.r_st, on="r", how="inner").join(stfeas, on="st", how="semi"))
    if on:
        ccfm = S.cost_cap_fin_mult.filter(pl.col("t") == year).rename({"value": "fin"})
        cc = S.cost_cap.filter(pl.col("t") == year).rename({"value": "cc"})
        scc = members(S.sccapcosttech)
        plain = vir.filter(~isin("i", scc))
        cg_plain = (plain.join(ccfm, on=["i", "r", "t"], how="inner").join(cc, on=["i", "t"], how="inner")
                    .with_columns((pl.col("fin") * pl.col("cc")).alias("value")).group_by(IST).agg(pl.col("value").min()))
        rfm = S.rsc_fin_mult.filter(pl.col("t") == year).rename({"value": "rfm"})
        cost = S.m_rsc_dat.filter(pl.col("sc_cat") == "cost").select(["r", "i", "rscbin", pl.col("value").alias("cost")])
        sc_rows = vir.filter(isin("i", scc))
        cg_sc = (sc_rows.join(rfm, on=["i", "r", "t"], how="inner").join(S.rscbin, how="cross")
                 .join(cost, on=["r", "i", "rscbin"], how="left")
                 .with_columns((pl.col("rfm") * pl.col("cost").fill_null(0.0)).alias("value")).group_by(IST).agg(pl.col("value").min()))
        cg = pl.concat([cg_plain, cg_sc])
        missing = anti(vir.select(IST).unique(), cg, IST)
        if missing.height:
            raise ValueError(f"cost_growth is undefined (GAMS smin over an empty set) for {missing.head(5).rows()}")
        S["cost_growth"] = nonzero(cg.with_columns(gams_round(pl.col("value"), 3).alias("value")))
    else:
        S["cost_growth"] = _empty(IST)
    prev = [y for y in years if y < yint]
    gap_obj = yint - (max(prev) if prev else 0)
    last = float(sw["Sw_GrowthPenLastYear"])
    mbs = float(S.model_builds_start_yr)
    coef = (vir.select(IST).unique().join(gbin, how="cross")
            .join(S.cost_growth.rename({"value": "cg"}), on=IST, how="inner")
            .join(S.growth_penalty.rename({"value": "gp"}), on="gbin", how="inner")
            .with_columns((pl.col("cg") * pl.col("gp") * float(gap_obj)).alias("value")).select(GB[:1] + IST + ["value"]))
    if not (on and mbs <= yint <= last):
        coef = coef.head(0)
    S["slice_objinv_GROWTH_BIN"] = nonzero(coef)
    return S
linopy build_linopy._add_row

rows = union of the term row tuples and the rows of the constant table, sorted; one LinearExpression over (eq_growthbin_limit_idx, _term), padded with label −1; add_constraints(expr, ">=", rhs, name="eq_growthbin_limit") — row ≥ rhs.

#coefficient tablevariable (index after rename)joined onrow index
1K[gbl_bin]GROWTH_BIN(gbin,i,st,t)(gbin,i,st,t)sum to (gbin,st,tg,t) → (gbin,st,tg,t)

rhs = −K[gbl_const] joined onto the rows (0 where the constant table has no row). Each (row, column) pair is summed before packing, zero coefficients are dropped, and the column label is the variable's position in its prep domain.

Helpers in this code: _on_domain, _term_entries, _add_row, anti, isin, members, nonzero, gams_round

pyoframe and polars operations in this code (syntax reference)
  • .rename({...}): rename index columns to line up with the row
  • how="semi": keep rows whose keys are in the other table ($-condition)
  • how="inner": keep matching rows of both (a missing factor removes the row)
  • how="left": keep every row of the left table (missing values become null, then 0)
  • how="cross": Cartesian product
  • fill_null(0.0): a missing GAMS parameter is 0
  • group_by(keys).agg(...): sum over the indices not in keys
  • pl.concat([...]): stack row sets (union of domains)
  • .unique(): distinct rows, so a domain has no duplicates
  • pl.when(c).then(a).otherwise(b): elementwise conditional (GAMS $ on a value)
Notes
  • GAMS skips the growth-bin update in the start year ($ifthene.post_startyear in 3_solve_oneyear.gms); the division there would be 0/0 otherwise.
  • No rows in either reference case (Sw_GrowthPenalties=0).
