if int(case.scalar("Sw_H2_PTC")) and sw_h2:
    ptc_year = tmodel.join(case["h2_ptc_years"], on="t", how="semi").filter(pl.col("t") >= h2_start)
    vg_ptc = case["valgen_h2ptc"].join(tmodel, on="t", how="semi")
    credit_base = vg_ptc.join(_in(h, "h", h_rep), how="cross").select(GEN_IDX)
    credit_used = []
    if ptc_year.height:
        credit_used.append(credit_base)
        P.con["eq_h2_ptc_creditgen"] = credit_base
        P.coef["ptcg_gen"] = _signed(P.var["GEN"].join(credit_base, on=GEN_IDX, how="semi"), GEN_IDX, 1.0)
        P.coef["ptcg_credit"] = _signed(credit_base, GEN_IDX, -1.0)
        match_year = case.scalar("h2_ptc_temporal_match_year")
        rreg = case["r_h2ptcreg"]
        ele = (P.var["PRODUCE"].filter((pl.col("p") == "h2") & (pl.col("i") == "electrolyzer")).join(case["prod_conversion_rate"].rename({"value": "pcr"}), on=V4, how="inner")
               .join(rreg, on="r", how="inner").with_columns((-(1.0 / pl.col("pcr"))).alias("value")))
        cred = credit_base.join(rreg, on="r", how="inner").with_columns(pl.lit(1.0).alias("value"))
        if (tmodel["t"] < match_year).all():
            rows = pl.concat([cred.select(["h2ptcreg", "t"]), ele.select(["h2ptcreg", "t"])]).unique()
            P.con["eq_h2_ptc_region_balance"] = rows
            P.coef["ptcb_credit"] = cred.select(["h2ptcreg"] + GEN_IDX + ["value"])
            P.coef["ptcb_produce"] = ele.select(["h2ptcreg"] + P6 + ["value"])
        else:
            rows = pl.concat([cred.select(["h2ptcreg", "h", "t"]), ele.select(["h2ptcreg", "h", "t"])]).unique()
            P.con["eq_h2_ptc_region_hour_balance"] = rows
            P.coef["ptch_credit"] = cred.select(["h2ptcreg"] + GEN_IDX + ["value"])
            P.coef["ptch_produce"] = ele.select(["h2ptcreg"] + P6 + ["value"])

pyoframe and polars operations in this code (syntax reference)
  • .rename({...}): rename index columns to line up with the row
  • how="semi": keep rows whose keys are in the other table ($-condition)
  • how="inner": keep matching rows of both (a missing factor removes the row)
  • how="cross": Cartesian product
  • pl.concat([...]): stack row sets (union of domains)
  • .unique(): distinct rows, so a domain has no duplicates
Notes
  • In both reference cases 2030 is at or after h2_ptc_temporal_match_year, so the hourly variant has the rows and this annual variant has none.

\(\displaystyle \V{Z}_{inv,t}\)\(\displaystyle = \P{pvf\_capital}_t\Big( \sum_{\mathrm{valinv}}\P{cost\_cap\_fin\_mult}_{i,r,t}\P{cost\_cap}_{i,t}\V{INV} + \sum_{\mathrm{valinv},\ \mathrm{battery}}\P{cost\_cap\_fin\_mult}\P{cost\_cap\_energy}\V{INV\_ENERGY} + \sum_{tg,r}\P{cap\_penalty}_{tg}\V{CAP\_ABOVE\_LIM} + (\text{growth penalties})\sw{Sw\_GrowthPenalties} \\ + \sum_{\mathrm{upgrade},\mathrm{valcap}}\P{cost\_upgrade}\P{cost\_cap\_fin\_mult}\V{UPGRADES}\sw{Sw\_Upgrades} + \sum_{\mathrm{m\_rscfeas},\mathrm{valinv},\mathrm{rsc\_i}\setminus\mathrm{spur}}\P{m\_rsc\_dat}_{\mathrm{cost}}\P{rsc\_fin\_mult}\sum_{ii\in\mathrm{rsc\_agg}(i)}\V{INV\_RSC}_{ii} + (\text{spur lines})\sw{Sw\_SpurScen} + \sum_r\P{trans\_cost\_cap\_fin\_mult}_t\,\mathrm{Sw\_TransIntraCost}\cdot1000\,\V{INV\_POI} + (\text{water})\sw{Sw\_WaterMain} \\ + \sum_{\mathrm{refurbtech},\mathrm{valinv}}\P{cost\_cap\_fin\_mult}\P{cost\_cap}\V{INV\_REFURB}\sw{Sw\_Refurb} + \sum_{\mathrm{routes\_inv}(AC),\ \mathrm{tsc\_binwidth}}\P{trans\_cost\_cap\_fin\_mult}\V{TRAN\_CAPEX\_BINS} + \sum_{\mathrm{routes\_inv},\ \tau\notin\mathrm{aclike}}\P{trans\_cost\_cap\_fin\_mult}\tfrac{\P{transmission\_cost\_nonac}}{2}\V{INVTRAN} + \sum_{\tau\in\mathrm{lcclike}}\P{trans\_cost\_cap\_fin\_mult}\,\P{cost\_acdc\_lcc}\V{INVTRAN} + (\text{VSC converters})\sw{Sw\_VSC} \\ + (\text{sdbin penalty})\sw{Sw\_PRM\_CapCredit} + \sum\P{cost\_cap\_fin\_mult}\P{cost\_cap\_up}\V{INV\_CAP\_UP} + \sum\P{cost\_cap\_fin\_mult}\P{cost\_ener\_up}\V{INV\_ENER\_UP} + \sum_{\mathrm{h2\_routes\_inv}}\P{cost\_h2\_transport\_cap}\V{H2\_TRANSPORT\_INV}\sw{Sw\_H2=2} + \sum_{\mathrm{h2\_stor\_r}}\P{cost\_h2\_storage\_cap}\V{H2\_STOR\_INV}\sw{Sw\_H2=2} + (\text{CO2 pipelines, spur lines})\sw{Sw\_CO2\_Detail}\Big)\)

eq_ObjFn_inv(t)$tmodel(t)..

         Z_inv(t)

         =e=

         pvf_capital(t) *

              (
* --- investment costs ---
                  + sum{(i,v,r)$valinv(i,v,r,t),
                       cost_cap_fin_mult(i,r,t) * cost_cap(i,t) * INV(i,v,r,t)
                      }

                  + sum{(i,v,r)$[valinv(i,v,r,t)$battery(i)],
                       cost_cap_fin_mult(i,r,t) * cost_cap_energy(i,t) * INV_ENERGY(i,v,r,t) 
                      }

* --- penalty for exceeding interconnection queue limit  ---
                  + sum{(tg,r), cap_penalty(tg) * CAP_ABOVE_LIM(tg,r,t) }    

* --- growth penalties ---
                  + sum{(gbin,i,st)$[sum{r$[r_st(r,st)], valinv_irt(i,r,t) }$stfeas(st)],
                        cost_growth(i,st,t) * growth_penalty(gbin) * (yeart(t) - sum{tt$[tprev(t,tt)], yeart(tt) }) * GROWTH_BIN(gbin,i,st,t)
                       }$[(yeart(t)>=model_builds_start_yr)$Sw_GrowthPenalties$(yeart(t)<=Sw_GrowthPenLastYear)]

* --- cost of upgrading---
                  + sum{(i,v,r)$[upgrade(i)$valcap(i,v,r,t)$Sw_Upgrades],
                         cost_upgrade(i,v,r,t) * cost_cap_fin_mult(i,r,t) * UPGRADES(i,v,r,t) }

* --- costs of resource supply curve spur line investment if not modeling explicitly---
*Note that cost_cap for hydro, pumped-hydro, and geo techs are zero
*but hydro and geo rsc_fin_mult is equal to the same value as cost_cap_fin_mult
* Note: for OSW, export cable, inter-array and POI/substations are eligible for ITC. The rest are not. 
* However we apply the ITC to all transmission costs to be consistent with LBW format
                  + sum{(i,v,r,rscbin)$[m_rscfeas(r,i,rscbin)$valinv(i,v,r,t)$rsc_i(i)$(not spur_techs(i))],
                      m_rsc_dat(r,i,rscbin,"cost") * rsc_fin_mult(i,r,t) * sum{ii$rsc_agg(i,ii), INV_RSC(ii,v,r,rscbin,t) } }

* ---cost of spur lines modeled explicitly---
* NOTE: no rsc_fin_mult(i,r,t) here, but it's 1 for upv and wind-ons anyway
                  + sum{x$[Sw_SpurScen$xfeas(x)],
                        spurline_cost(x) * Sw_SpurCostMult * INV_SPUR(x,t) }

* --- cost of intra-zone network reinforcement (a.k.a. point-of-interconnection capacity or POI)
* Sw_TransIntraCost is in $/kW, so multiply by 1000 to convert to $/MW
                  + sum{r$Sw_TransIntraCost,
                        trans_cost_cap_fin_mult(t) * Sw_TransIntraCost * 1000 * INV_POI(r,t) }

* --- cost of water access---
                  + [ (8760/1E6) * sum{ (i,v,w,r)$[i_w(i,w)$valinv(i,v,r,t)], sum{wst$i_wst(i,wst),
                                     m_watsc_dat(wst,"cost",r,t) } * water_rate(i,w) *
                                        ( INV(i,v,r,t) + INV_REFURB(i,v,r,t)$[refurbtech(i)$Sw_Refurb] ) }
                      + sum{(rscbin,i,v,r)$[m_rscfeas(r,i,rscbin)$psh(i)],
                              sum{wst$i_wst(i,wst), m_watsc_dat(wst,"cost",r,t) } *
                              ( INV_RSC(i,v,r,rscbin,t) * water_req_psh(r,rscbin) ) }$Sw_PSHwatercon
                    ]$Sw_WaterMain

*slack variable to update water source type (wst) in the unit database
*Note that existing wst data is not consistent with availability of water source in the region
                  + sum{(wst,r), 1E6 * WATER_CAPACITY_LIMIT_SLACK(wst,r,t) }$[Sw_WaterMain$Sw_WaterCapacity]

* --- cost of refurbishments of RSC tech---
                  + sum{(i,v,r)$[Sw_Refurb$valinv(i,v,r,t)$refurbtech(i)],
                      cost_cap_fin_mult(i,r,t) * cost_cap(i,t) * INV_REFURB(i,v,r,t)
                      }

* --- cost of interzonal AC transmission---
                  + sum{(r,rr,tscbin)$[routes_inv(r,rr,"AC",t)$tsc_binwidth(r,rr,tscbin)],
                        trans_cost_cap_fin_mult(t) * TRAN_CAPEX_BINS(r,rr,tscbin,t) }

* --- cost of interzonal HVDC transmission---
* transmission lines: 1 MW adds 1 MW to both INVTRAN(r,rr) and INVTRAN(rr,r) so divide by 2
                  + sum{(r,rr,trtype)$[routes_inv(r,rr,trtype,t)$(not aclike(trtype))],
                        trans_cost_cap_fin_mult(t)
                        * transmission_cost_nonac(r,rr,trtype)
                        * INVTRAN(r,rr,trtype,t)
                        / 2 }

* LCC and B2B AC/DC converter stations: each interface has two, one on either side of the interface,
* but each interface shows up in both INVTRAN(r,rr) and INVTRAN(rr,r) so don't multiply by 2
                  + sum{(r,rr,trtype)$[lcclike(trtype)$routes_inv(r,rr,trtype,t)],
                        trans_cost_cap_fin_mult(t) * cost_acdc_lcc * INVTRAN(r,rr,trtype,t) }

* VSC AC/DC converter stations
                  + sum{r$val_converter(r,t),
                        trans_cost_cap_fin_mult(t) * cost_acdc_vsc * INV_CONVERTER(r,t) }

* --- storage capacity credit---
*small cost penalty to incentivize solver to fill shorter-duration bins first
                  + sum{(i,v,r,ccseason,sdbin)$[valcap(i,v,r,t)$(storage(i) or hyd_add_pump(i))$(not csp(i))$Sw_PRM_CapCredit$Sw_StorageBinPenalty],
                         bin_penalty(sdbin) * CAP_SDBIN(i,v,r,ccseason,sdbin,t) }

* cost of capacity upsizing
                  + sum{(i,v,r,rscbin)$allow_cap_up(i,v,r,rscbin,t),
                            cost_cap_fin_mult(i,r,t) * INV_CAP_UP(i,v,r,rscbin,t) * cost_cap_up(i,v,r,rscbin,t) }

* cost of energy upsizing
                  + sum{(i,v,r,rscbin)$allow_ener_up(i,v,r,rscbin,t),
                            cost_cap_fin_mult(i,r,t) * INV_ENER_UP(i,v,r,rscbin,t) * cost_ener_up(i,v,r,rscbin,t) }

* H2 transport network investment costs
                  + sum{(r,rr)$h2_routes_inv(r,rr), cost_h2_transport_cap(r,rr,t) * H2_TRANSPORT_INV(r,rr,t) }$(Sw_H2 = 2)

* H2 storage investment costs 
                  + sum{(h2_stor,r)$h2_stor_r(h2_stor,r), cost_h2_storage_cap(h2_stor,t) * H2_STOR_INV(h2_stor,r,t) }$(Sw_H2 = 2)

* CO2 pipeline investment costs
                  + sum{(r,rr)$co2_routes(r,rr), cost_co2_pipeline_cap(r,rr,t) * CO2_TRANSPORT_INV(r,rr,t)
                                                  }$[Sw_CO2_Detail$(yeart(t)>=co2_detail_startyr)]

                  + sum{(r,cs)$[csfeas(cs)$r_cs(r,cs)], cost_co2_spurline_cap(r,cs,t) * CO2_SPURLINE_INV(r,cs,t)
                                                  }$[Sw_CO2_Detail$(yeart(t)>=co2_detail_startyr)]

*end to multiplier by pvf_capital
            )

prep.py:1561
cs = case.scalar("cost_scale")
pvc = case["pvf_capital"].rename({"value": "pvc"})
pvo = case["pvf_onm"].rename({"value": "pvo"})

def _scale(df, pv, pvname):
    return (df.join(pv, on="t", how="inner")
            .with_columns((cs * pl.col("value") * pl.col(pvname)).alias("value")).drop(pvname))

def _objective(var, table, pv, pvname):
    keys = list(P.var[var].columns)
    coef = case[table].select(keys + ["value"])
    on_domain = coef.join(P.var[var], on=keys, how="semi")
    P.options["objective_rows_off_domain"][table] = coef.height - on_domain.height
    return _scale(on_domain, pv, pvname)

P.options["objective_rows_off_domain"] = {}
inv_terms = {"INV": "slice_objinv_INV", "INV_ENERGY": "slice_objinv_INV_ENERGY", "INV_CONVERTER": "slice_objinv_INV_CONVERTER",
             "INV_RSC": "slice_objinv_INV_RSC", "UPGRADES": "slice_objinv_UPGRADES", "INV_REFURB": "slice_objinv_INV_REFURB",
             "INV_CAP_UP": "slice_objinv_INV_CAP_UP", "INV_ENER_UP": "slice_objinv_INV_ENER_UP",
             "INVTRAN": "slice_objinv_INVTRAN", "TRAN_CAPEX_BINS": "slice_objinv_TRAN_CAPEX_BINS", "INV_POI": "slice_objinv_INV_POI",
             "CAP_ABOVE_LIM": "slice_objinv_CAP_ABOVE_LIM", "GROWTH_BIN": "slice_objinv_GROWTH_BIN", "H2_STOR_INV": "slice_objinv_H2_STOR_INV",
             "H2_TRANSPORT_INV": "slice_objinv_H2_TRANSPORT_INV", "INV_SPUR": "slice_objinv_INV_SPUR"}
op_terms = {"GEN": "slice_objop_GEN", "CAP": "slice_objop_CAP", "INV": "slice_objop_INV", "CAP_CONVERTER": "slice_objop_CAP_CONVERTER",
            "CAP_ENERGY": "slice_objop_CAP_ENERGY", "CAPTRAN_ENERGY": "slice_objop_CAPTRAN_ENERGY",
            "FLOW": "slice_objop_FLOW", "EMIT": "slice_objop_EMIT", "CAP_RSC": "slice_objop_CAP_RSC",
            "INV_REFURB": "slice_objop_INV_REFURB", "UPGRADES": "slice_objop_UPGRADES",
            "OPRES": "slice_objop_OPRES", "RAMPUP": "slice_objop_RAMPUP", "BIOUSED": "slice_objop_BIOUSED",
            "INV_POI": "slice_objop_INV_POI", "ACP_PURCHASES": "slice_objop_ACP_PURCHASES",
            "PRODUCE": "slice_objop_PRODUCE", "H2_STOR_CAP": "slice_objop_H2_STOR_CAP", "H2_TRANSPORT_INV": "slice_objop_H2_TRANSPORT_INV",
            "DROPPED": "slice_objop_DROPPED", "EXCESS": "slice_objop_EXCESS",
            "VGASBINQ_REGIONAL": "slice_objop_VGASBINQ_REGIONAL", "VGASBINQ_NATIONAL": "slice_objop_VGASBINQ_NATIONAL",
            "CAP_SPUR": "slice_objop_CAP_SPUR"}
for var, table in inv_terms.items():
    if var not in P.var:
        continue
    P.obj[var] = _objective(var, table, pvc, "pvc")
for var, table in op_terms.items():
    if var not in P.var:
        continue
    term = _objective(var, table, pvo, "pvo")
    if var in P.obj:
        keys = list(P.var[var].columns)
        P.obj[var] = (pl.concat([P.obj[var], term]).group_by(keys).agg(pl.col("value").sum()))
    else:
        P.obj[var] = term
for var in list(P.obj):
    P.obj[var] = P.obj[var].filter(pl.col("value") != 0.0)
if "INVTRAN" in P.var and case["slice_trans_cost"].height:
    P.obj["INVTRAN"] = _scale(
        P.var["INVTRAN"].join(tmodel, on="t", how="semi").join(case["slice_trans_cost"], on=["r", "rr", "trtype"], how="inner"),
        pvc, "pvc")
return _sorted(P)

Helpers in this code: _scale, _objective, _sorted, P, anti, isin, members, fsum_by, nonzero, yr

pyoframe and polars operations in this code (syntax reference)
  • .rename({...}): rename index columns to line up with the row
  • how="semi": keep rows whose keys are in the other table ($-condition)
  • how="inner": keep matching rows of both (a missing factor removes the row)
  • how="cross": Cartesian product
  • group_by(keys).agg(...): sum over the indices not in keys
  • pl.concat([...]): stack row sets (union of domains)
Notes
  • The GAMS objective is Z = cost_scale × Σ_t (Z_inv + Z_op); the port minimizes Σ (coefficient × variable) with the coefficient already multiplied by cost_scale and the present-value factor, and compares against the GAMS objective minus its constant part (gate 2).
  • Columns that appear only in the objective (no constraint row) are kept, as GAMS CONVERT keeps them.

* --- variable O&M costs---

* capacity to each end of the link. But because CAPTRAN_ENERGY is defined in both directions
* (r < rr and rr < r), we already count the link capacity twice, so don't need to multiply

cs = case.scalar("cost_scale")
pvc = case["pvf_capital"].rename({"value": "pvc"})
pvo = case["pvf_onm"].rename({"value": "pvo"})

def _scale(df, pv, pvname):
    return (df.join(pv, on="t", how="inner")
            .with_columns((cs * pl.col("value") * pl.col(pvname)).alias("value")).drop(pvname))

def _objective(var, table, pv, pvname):
    keys = list(P.var[var].columns)
    coef = case[table].select(keys + ["value"])
    on_domain = coef.join(P.var[var], on=keys, how="semi")
    P.options["objective_rows_off_domain"][table] = coef.height - on_domain.height
    return _scale(on_domain, pv, pvname)

P.options["objective_rows_off_domain"] = {}
inv_terms = {"INV": "slice_objinv_INV", "INV_ENERGY": "slice_objinv_INV_ENERGY", "INV_CONVERTER": "slice_objinv_INV_CONVERTER",
             "INV_RSC": "slice_objinv_INV_RSC", "UPGRADES": "slice_objinv_UPGRADES", "INV_REFURB": "slice_objinv_INV_REFURB",
             "INV_CAP_UP": "slice_objinv_INV_CAP_UP", "INV_ENER_UP": "slice_objinv_INV_ENER_UP",
             "INVTRAN": "slice_objinv_INVTRAN", "TRAN_CAPEX_BINS": "slice_objinv_TRAN_CAPEX_BINS", "INV_POI": "slice_objinv_INV_POI",

Helpers in this code: _scale, _objective, _sorted, P, semi, isin, members, fsum_by, nonzero

pyoframe and polars operations in this code (syntax reference)
  • .rename({...}): rename index columns to line up with the row
  • how="semi": keep rows whose keys are in the other table ($-condition)
  • how="inner": keep matching rows of both (a missing factor removes the row)
  • how="left": keep every row of the left table (missing values become null, then 0)
  • how="cross": Cartesian product
  • fill_null(0.0): a missing GAMS parameter is 0
  • group_by(keys).agg(...): sum over the indices not in keys
  • pl.concat([...]): stack row sets (union of domains)
  • .unique(): distinct rows, so a domain has no duplicates
  • pl.when(c).then(a).otherwise(b): elementwise conditional (GAMS $ on a value)
Notes
  • The H2 fuel cost for h2_gen technologies is charged only in stress hours (or when Sw_H2=0), as the GAMS condition says; fixed_fuel in derive_temporal encodes that condition.
  • The prior-year INV_POI FOM term is a constant in the current year's LP; GAMS carries it in the objective constant, which gate 2 removes before comparing objective values.

               .with_columns((-(pl.col("hrs") * pl.col("hr"))).alias("value")).select(GEN_IDX + ["value"]))
    P.con["eq_gasaccounting_regional"] = cendiv.join(tmodel, how="cross").select(["cendiv", "t"])
    P.coef["gasacc_reg_bin"] = _signed(P.var["VGASBINQ_REGIONAL"], FC, 1.0)
    P.coef["gasacc_reg_gen"] = gas_gen.join(case["r_cendiv"], on="r", how="inner").select(GEN_IDX + ["cendiv", "value"])
    P.con["eq_gasaccounting_national"] = tmodel.select("t")
    P.coef["gasacc_nat_bin"] = _signed(P.var["VGASBINQ_NATIONAL"], ["fuelbin", "t"], 1.0)

    P.con["eq_gasbinlimit_regional"] = P.var["VGASBINQ_REGIONAL"]

    P.coef["gasbin_reg_var"] = _signed(P.var["VGASBINQ_REGIONAL"], FC, -1.0)

    gas_gen = (_in(valgen, "i", S["gas"]).join(case["heat_rate"].rename({"value": "hr"}), on=V4, how="inner")
               .join(case["hours"].rename({"value": "hrs"}), how="cross")

    P.con["eq_gasaccounting_regional"] = cendiv.join(tmodel, how="cross").select(["cendiv", "t"])

eq_reserve_margin(r,ccseason,t) not ported

--MW-- planning reserve margin requirement

group: none · v20261010_Pacific_full (pyoframe): 0 rows · v20261009_Pacific_slice (pyoframe): 0 rows · r2_Pacific_mid (pyoframe): 0 rows · r2_Pacific_mid (linopy): 0 rows · r3_WECC_oracle (pyoframe): 0 rows · GAMS source: reeds/core/setup/c_model.gms:1690

Planning reserve margin with capacity credits (capacity-credit mode).

\(\displaystyle \sum_{\substack{\mathrm{valcap},\ i\notin\mathrm{vre}\cup\mathrm{hydro}\cup\mathrm{storage}\cup\mathrm{consume},\\ \neg\mathrm{forced\_retire}}}\V{CAP}(1+\P{ccseason\_cap\_frac\_delta})(1-\P{mean\_forced\_outage\_rate})\)\(\displaystyle + \sum_{\mathrm{vre}\cup\mathrm{csp}\cup\mathrm{pvb}}\P{cc\_old}_{i,r,cc,t}\)\(\displaystyle + \sum_{\mathrm{valinv}}\P{m\_cc\_mar}_{i,r,cc,t}(\V{INV}+\V{INV\_REFURB})\)\(\displaystyle + \sum_{sdbin}\P{cc\_storage}_{i,sdbin}\V{CAP\_SDBIN}\)\(\displaystyle + \sum_{\mathrm{hybrid}}\P{cc\_storage}\P{hybrid\_cc\_derate}\V{CAP\_SDBIN}\)\(\displaystyle + \sum\P{cc\_int}\V{CAP}\)\(\displaystyle + \sum\P{cc\_excess}\)\(\displaystyle + \sum_{\mathrm{hydro\_nd},\ h\in\mathrm{h\_ccseason\_prm}(cc)}\V{GEN}\)\(\displaystyle + \sum_{\mathrm{hydro\_d}\cup\mathrm{hyd\_add\_pump}}\V{CAP}\,\P{cap\_hyd\_ccseason\_adj}(1+\P{hydro\_capcredit\_delta})\)\(\displaystyle + \sum_{\mathrm{routes\_prm},\ \mathrm{notvsc}}(1-\P{tranloss})\V{PRMTRADE}_{rr\to r}\)\(\displaystyle - \sum\V{PRMTRADE}_{r\to rr} \pm \V{CONVERSION\_PRM}\sw{Sw\_VSC}\)\(\displaystyle \ge\; \Big(\P{peakdem\_static\_ccseason}_{r,cc,t} + \frac{\sum_{\mathrm{smr}}\V{PRODUCE}/\P{pcr}\cdot\P{hours}\P{frac\_h\_ccseason\_weights}}{\sum\P{hours}\P{frac\_h\_ccseason\_weights}}\sw{Sw\_Prod}\Big)(1+\P{prm}_{r,t})\)
GAMS reeds/core/setup/c_model.gms:1690
eq_reserve_margin(r,ccseason,t)
    $[tmodel(t)$(yeart(t)>=model_builds_start_yr)
    $Sw_PRM_CapCredit
    $(not Sw_PCM)]..

* forced_retire is used here because forced_retire capacity is removed from valgen 
* but not valcap. It remains in valcap to allow for upgrades, but if it is not upgraged
* it should not be allowed to provide capacity to meet the reserve margin constraint.
* Because it can provide no services, it will either upgrade or retire.

*[plus] sum of all non-rsc and non-storage capacity
    + sum{(i,v)$[valcap(i,v,r,t)$(not vre(i))$(not hydro(i))$(not storage(i))$(not consume(i))$(not forced_retire(i,r,t))],
          CAP(i,v,r,t)
          * (1 + ccseason_cap_frac_delta(i,v,r,ccseason,t))
          * (1 - mean_forced_outage_rate(i,r,ccseason,t))
         }

*[plus] firm capacity from existing VRE or CSP
*only used in sequential solve case (otherwise cc_old = 0)
    + sum{i$[(vre(i) or csp(i) or pvb(i))$(not forced_retire(i,r,t))],
          cc_old(i,r,ccseason,t)
         }

*[plus] marginal capacity credit of VRE and csp times new investment
*only used in sequential solve case (otherwise m_cc_mar = 0)
*Note: new distpv is included with cc_old
    + sum{(i,v)$[(vre(i) or csp(i) or pvb(i))$valinv(i,v,r,t)$(not forced_retire(i,r,t))],
          m_cc_mar(i,r,ccseason,t) * (INV(i,v,r,t) + INV_REFURB(i,v,r,t)$[refurbtech(i)$Sw_Refurb])
         }

*[plus] firm capacity contribution from all binned storage capacity
*battery and pumped-hydro
*excludes hydro upgraded to add pumps
    + sum{(i,v,sdbin)$[(storage_standalone(i) or hyd_add_pump(i))$valcap(i,v,r,t)$(not forced_retire(i,r,t))],
          cc_storage(i,sdbin) * CAP_SDBIN(i,v,r,ccseason,sdbin,t)
         }
*hybrid PV+battery
    + sum{(i,v,sdbin)$[storage_hybrid(i)$(not csp(i))$valcap(i,v,r,t)$(not forced_retire(i,r,t))],
          cc_storage(i,sdbin) * hybrid_cc_derate(i,r,ccseason,sdbin,t) * CAP_SDBIN(i,v,r,ccseason,sdbin,t)
         }

*[plus] average capacity credit times capacity of VRE and storage
*used in rolling window and full intertemporal solve (otherwise cc_int = 0)
    + sum{(i,v)$[(vre(i) or storage(i))$valcap(i,v,r,t)$(not forced_retire(i,r,t))],
          cc_int(i,v,r,ccseason,t) * CAP(i,v,r,t)
         }

*[plus] excess capacity credit
*used in rolling window and full intertemporal solve when using marginals for cc_int (otherwise cc_excess = 0)
    + sum{i$[(vre(i) or storage(i))$(not forced_retire(i,r,t))],
          cc_excess(i,r,ccseason,t)
         }

*[plus] firm capacity of non-dispatchable hydro
* nb: hydro_nd generation does not fluctuate
* within a seasons set of hours
    + sum{(i,v,h)$[hydro_nd(i)$valgen(i,v,r,t)$h_ccseason_prm(h,ccseason)],
          GEN(i,v,r,h,t)
         }

*[plus] dispatchable hydro firm capacity
* include hydro upgraded to add pumps
    + sum{(i,v)$[(hydro_d(i) or hyd_add_pump(i))$valcap(i,v,r,t)$(not forced_retire(i,r,t))],
          CAP(i,v,r,t) * cap_hyd_ccseason_adj(i,ccseason,r) * (1 + hydro_capcredit_delta(i,t))
         }

*[plus] imports of firm capacity through AC and LCC DC lines
    + sum{(rr,trtype)$[routes(rr,r,trtype,t)$routes_prm(rr,r)$notvsc(trtype)],
          (1 - tranloss(rr,r,trtype)) * PRMTRADE(rr,r,trtype,ccseason,t)
         }

*[minus] exports of firm capacity through AC and LCC DC lines
    - sum{(rr,trtype)$[routes(r,rr,trtype,t)$routes_prm(r,rr)$notvsc(trtype)],
          PRMTRADE(r,rr,trtype,ccseason,t)
         }

*[plus] net AC/DC conversion of firm capacity through VSC converters
    + (CONVERSION_PRM(r,ccseason,"VSC","AC",t) * converter_efficiency_vsc)$[Sw_VSC$val_converter(r,t)]
    - (CONVERSION_PRM(r,ccseason,"AC","VSC",t) / converter_efficiency_vsc)$[Sw_VSC$val_converter(r,t)]

    =g=

*[plus] the peak demand times the planning reserve margin
    + (
        peakdem_static_ccseason(r,ccseason,t)

*         + PEAK_FLEX(r,ccseason,t)$Sw_EFS_flex

* [plus] only steam methane reforming technologies are assumed to increase peak demand
* contribution to peak demand based on weighted-average across timeslices in each ccseason
* [metric tons/hour] / [metric tons/MWh] * [hours] / [hours] = [MW]
     + (sum{(p,i,v,h)$[smr(i)$valcap(i,v,r,t)$frac_h_ccseason_weights(h,ccseason)
                     $(sameas(p,"H2"))$i_p(i,p)$(not sameas(i,"dac_gas"))$h_rep(h)],
            PRODUCE(p,i,v,r,h,t) / prod_conversion_rate(i,v,r,t)
            * hours(h) * frac_h_ccseason_weights(h,ccseason) }
        / sum{h$[frac_h_ccseason_weights(h,ccseason)$h_rep(h)],
              hours(h) * frac_h_ccseason_weights(h,ccseason) }
     )$Sw_Prod

      ) * (1 + prm(r,t))

Not ported and no guard. This equation belongs to the operating-reserve family (Sw_OpRes). Shared helpers

_in reeds/open/prep.py

Keep the rows whose column col is a member of a set. GAMS: a $set(i) condition on one index.

prep.py:35
def _in(df: pl.DataFrame, col: str, members) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return df.filter(pl.col(col).is_in(list(members)))

_not_in reeds/open/prep.py

Keep the rows whose column col is not a member of a set. GAMS: $[not set(i)].

prep.py:39
def _not_in(df: pl.DataFrame, col: str, members) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return df.filter(~pl.col(col).is_in(list(members)))

_on_domain reeds/open/prep.py

Left-join a parameter onto a constraint domain and fill missing values with 0, so a GAMS row whose constant is zero still exists.

prep.py:43
def _on_domain(domain: pl.DataFrame, par: pl.DataFrame, keys: list[str]) -> pl.DataFrame:
    """Left-join a parameter onto a domain and fill missing values with 0."""
    out = domain.join(par.select(keys + ["value"]), on=keys, how="left")
    return out.with_columns(pl.col("value").fill_null(0.0))

_add reeds/open/prep.py

Add sign × right onto the rows of left; a missing right value counts as 0, as a missing GAMS parameter does.

prep.py:49
def _add(left: pl.DataFrame, right: pl.DataFrame, on: list[str], sign: float = 1.0) -> pl.DataFrame:
    out = left.join(right.select(on + ["value"]).rename({"value": "_v2"}), on=on, how="left")
    return out.with_columns((pl.col("value") + sign * pl.col("_v2").fill_null(0.0)).alias("value")).drop("_v2")

_signed reeds/open/prep.py

A coefficient table with a constant value on every row of a domain.

prep.py:64
def _signed(df: pl.DataFrame, keys: list[str], sign: float) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return df.select(keys).with_columns(pl.lit(float(sign)).alias("value"))

_mul reeds/open/prep.py

Inner join of two coefficient tables with the values multiplied (GAMS: missing = 0).

prep.py:68
def _mul(left: pl.DataFrame, right: pl.DataFrame, on: list[str]) -> pl.DataFrame:
    """Inner-join two coefficient tables and multiply their values (GAMS: missing = 0)."""
    out = left.join(right.rename({"value": "_v2"}), on=on, how="inner")
    return out.with_columns((pl.col("value") * pl.col("_v2")).alias("value")).drop("_v2")

_fsum reeds/open/prep.py

Group-by sum with math.fsum, which matches GAMS extended-precision accumulation.

prep.py:59
def _fsum(df: pl.DataFrame, keys: list[str]) -> pl.DataFrame:
    from .derive import fsum_by
    return fsum_by(df.select(keys + ["value"]), keys)

_stock_terms reeds/open/prep.py

For a capacity-stock domain: the coefficient table of the current-year investment variable and the constant that collects prior-year investments (state tables), prescribed retirements and an optional exogenous addition.

prep.py:225
def _stock_terms(domain, inv_var, state_name, ret_name=None, extra_name=None):
    """Coefficient of current-year investment and the constant from past years."""
    if inv_var not in P.var:
        return (pl.DataFrame(schema={c: pl.Utf8 for c in ["i", "v", "r"]} | {"t": pl.Int64, "tt": pl.Int64, "value": pl.Float64}),
                domain.select(V4).with_columns(pl.lit(0.0).alias("value")))
    cond = case["inv_cond"].join(domain, on=V4, how="semi")
    dn = case["degrade_new"]
    cur = (cond.join(tmodel.rename({"t": "tt"}), on="tt", how="semi")
           .join(P.var[inv_var].rename({"t": "tt"}), on=["i", "v", "r", "tt"], how="semi")
           .join(dn, on=["i", "tt", "t"], how="inner")
           .select(V4 + ["tt", "value"]))
    past_c = (cond.join(tfix.rename({"t": "tt"}), on="tt", how="semi")
              .join(dn, on=["i", "tt", "t"], how="inner")
              .join(case[state_name].rename({"value": "lvl"}), on=["i", "v", "r", "tt"], how="inner")
              .with_columns((pl.col("value") * pl.col("lvl")).alias("value"))
              .group_by(V4).agg(pl.col("value").sum()))
    const = _on_domain(domain, past_c, V4)
    if ret_name is not None:
        const = _add(const, case[ret_name], V4, sign=-1.0)
    if extra_name is not None:
        ex = case[extra_name].select(V4 + ["value"])
        const = (const.join(ex.rename({"value": "ex"}), on=V4, how="left")
                 .with_columns((pl.col("value") + pl.col("ex").fill_null(0.0)).alias("value"))
                 .drop("ex"))
    return cur, const

_netup_cur reeds/open/prep.py

Current-year UPGRADES and UPGRADES_RETIRE columns of the upgrade techs ii that upgrade from i, with the GAMS right-hand-side signs.

prep.py:296
def _netup_cur(domain):
    rows = domain.select(V4).join(link, on="i", how="inner")
    up = rows.join(P.var["UPGRADES"].rename({"i": "ii"}), on=["ii", "v", "r", "t"], how="semi") if "UPGRADES" in P.var else rows.head(0)
    ret = (rows.join(P.var["UPGRADES_RETIRE"].rename({"i": "ii"}), on=["ii", "v", "r", "t"], how="semi")
           if "UPGRADES_RETIRE" in P.var else rows.head(0))
    return _signed(up, V4 + ["ii"], -1.0), _signed(ret, V4 + ["ii"], 1.0)

_netup_past reeds/open/prep.py

Net prior-year upgrades Σ(UPGRADES − UPGRADES_RETIRE) of techs ii upgrading from i, over fixed years up to the column named by upto.

prep.py:303
def _netup_past(domain, upto):
    rows = domain.join(link, on="i", how="inner")
    st_up = case["state_UPGRADES"].rename({"i": "ii"}).join(valcap_tfix.rename({"i": "ii"}), on=["ii", "v", "r", "tt"], how="semi")
    st_ret = case["state_UPGRADES_RETIRE"].rename({"i": "ii"}).join(valcap_tfix.rename({"i": "ii"}), on=["ii", "v", "r", "tt"], how="semi")
    st_ret = _not_in(st_ret, "ii", noret)
    st_up = st_up.rename({"tt": "ttt"})
    st_ret = st_ret.rename({"tt": "ttt"})
    up = rows.join(st_up, on=["ii", "v", "r"], how="inner").filter(pl.col("ttt") <= pl.col(upto))
    ret = rows.join(st_ret, on=["ii", "v", "r"], how="inner").filter(pl.col("ttt") <= pl.col(upto))
    both = pl.concat([up.select(V4 + ["value"]), ret.with_columns((-pl.col("value")).alias("value")).select(V4 + ["value"])])
    return both.group_by(V4).agg(pl.col("value").sum())

_prev_cap reeds/open/prep.py

Constant for the retmo equations: CAP of the previous solve year (optionally degraded) plus net upgrades up to that year, minus net prior-year upgrades up to the current year.

prep.py:315
def _prev_cap(domain, degrade):
    prev = (domain.join(tprev, on="t", how="inner")
            .join(valcap_tfix, on=["i", "v", "r", "tt"], how="semi")
            .join(case["state_CAP"].rename({"value": "cap_prev"}), on=["i", "v", "r", "tt"], how="left")
            .with_columns(pl.col("cap_prev").fill_null(0.0)))
    if degrade:
        prev = (prev.join(dn, on=["i", "tt", "t"], how="left")
                .with_columns((pl.col("cap_prev") * pl.col("value").fill_null(0.0)).alias("cap_prev")).drop("value"))
    const = _on_domain(domain, prev.select(V4 + [pl.col("cap_prev").alias("value")]), V4)
    const = _add(const, _netup_past(prev.select(V4 + ["tt"]), "tt"), V4)
    return _add(const, _netup_past(domain, "t"), V4, sign=-1.0)

def _capup_terms(domain, degrade):
    cur = allow_cap.join(domain, on=V4, how="semi")
    if degrade:
        cur = (cur.join(dn.filter(pl.col("tt") == pl.col("t")).select(["i", "t", "value"]), on=["i", "t"], how="left")
               .with_columns(pl.col("value").fill_null(0.0)))
    else:
        cur = cur.with_columns(pl.lit(1.0).alias("value"))
    past = (case["state_INV_CAP_UP"].join(tfix_tt, on="tt", how="semi")
            .join(case["allow_cap_up"].rename({"t": "tt"}), on=["i", "v", "r", "rscbin", "tt"], how="semi")
            .join(domain, on=["i", "v", "r"], how="inner"))
    if degrade:
        past = past.join(dn, on=["i", "tt", "t"], how="inner").with_columns((pl.col("value") * pl.col("value_right")).alias("value"))
    past = past.group_by(V4).agg(pl.col("value").sum())
    return cur.select(RSC_IDX + ["value"]), past

load_terms reeds/open/prep.py

REC requirement load terms by RecStyle: constants from Canada exports, LOAD coefficients and GEN coefficients (distpv / all gen).

prep.py:1165
def load_terms(rows, region_map, ces_exports):
    rr = rows.join(style, on=["st", "rpscat"], how="left").with_columns(pl.col("style").fill_null(0.0))
    reg = rr.join(region_map, on="st", how="inner").join(hours_rep.rename({"value": "hrs"}), how="cross")
    f01 = pl.when(pl.col("style") == 0.0).then((1.0 - dl) * pl.col("hrs")).when(pl.col("style") == 1.0).then(pl.col("hrs")).otherwise(None)
    load = (reg.filter(pl.col("style") < 2.0).with_columns((-(f01 * pl.col("mult"))).alias("value"))
            .select(RQ + ["r", "h", "value"]))
    gen_d = (reg.filter(pl.col("style") < 2.0).join(distpv_gen, on=["r", "h", "t"], how="inner")
             .with_columns((f01 * pl.col("mult")).alias("value")).select(RQ + ["i", "v", "r", "h", "value"]))
    gen2 = (reg.filter(pl.col("style") == 2.0).join(_not_in(P.var["GEN"], "i", S["storage_standalone"]), on=["r", "h", "t"], how="inner")
            .with_columns((-((pl.when(pl.col("i").is_in(list(S["distpv"]))).then(1.0 + (-dl)).otherwise(1.0) * pl.col("hrs")) * pl.col("mult"))).alias("value"))
            .select(RQ + ["i", "v", "r", "h", "value"]))
    c = (reg.join(ce, on=["r", "h", "t"], how="inner")
         .with_columns(pl.when(pl.col("style") == 0.0).then(((pl.col("ce") * (1.0 - dl)) * pl.col("hrs")) * pl.col("mult"))
                       .when(pl.col("style") == 1.0).then((pl.col("ce") * pl.col("hrs")) * pl.col("mult"))
                       .otherwise(pl.when(pl.col("rpscat") == "ces").then((pl.col("ce") * pl.col("hrs")) * pl.col("mult")).otherwise(0.0) if ces_exports else 0.0).alias("value"))
         .group_by(RQ).agg(pl.col("value").sum()))
    return c, load, pl.concat([gen_d, gen2])

def bundled_terms(rows_cat, cat_b, sign, direction):
    base = recs_dom.filter((pl.col("rpscat") == cat_b) & (pl.col("st") != pl.col("ast"))).join(stfeas.rename({"st": "ast"}), on="ast", how="semi")

    keyed = keyed.join(rows_cat.rename({"st": "st_row"}).select(["st_row", "t"]), on=["st_row", "t"], how="semi")
    return keyed.with_columns(pl.lit(float(sign)).alias("value"))

def recs_coef(parts, row_cat_col):

def _objective(var, table, pv, pvname):
    keys = list(P.var[var].columns)
    coef = case[table].select(keys + ["value"])
    on_domain = coef.join(P.var[var], on=keys, how="semi")

    return _scale(on_domain, pv, pvname)

_sorted reeds/open/prep.py

Sort every domain and coefficient table by its index columns so row and column order, and hence the vertex HiGHS returns, are reproducible.

prep.py:1615
def _sorted(P: Prepared) -> Prepared:
    """Sort every table by its index columns.

    polars joins and group_bys do not guarantee row order, and row/column
    order decides which optimal vertex a degenerate LP lands on. Sorting makes
    primal and dual solutions reproducible from run to run.
    """
    for store in (P.var, P.con, P.coef, P.obj):
        for k, df in store.items():
            if isinstance(df, pl.DataFrame) and df.height:
                keys = [c for c in df.columns if c != "value"]
                store[k] = df.sort(keys)
    return P

_row reeds/open/build_pyoframe.py

Build one constraint from a constant table and a list of (coefficient table, variable, rename, sum_by[, post-rename]) terms; the row set is the union of the term rows, missing terms count as zero.

build_pyoframe.py:33
def _row(m: pf.Model, C: dict, K: dict, name: str, row: Row) -> None:
    if name not in C or C[name].height == 0:
        return
    parts = [P(K[row.const])] if row.const else []
    for term in row.terms:
        if term.coef not in K or not hasattr(m, term.var):
            continue
        df = K[term.coef]
        if df.height == 0:
            continue
        v = getattr(m, term.var)
        if term.rename:
            v = v.rename(term.rename)
        e = P(df) * v
        if term.sum_by:
            e = e.sum_by(*term.sum_by)
        if term.post:
            e = e.rename(term.post)
        parts.append(e)
    expr = U(*parts)
    setattr(m, name, expr >= 0 if row.sense == ">=" else expr == 0)

U reeds/open/build_pyoframe.py

Union-sum of pyoframe expressions: each term is marked keep_extras(), so a label present in only one term is kept and the missing terms count as 0 (a GAMS sum of terms defined over different domains).

build_pyoframe.py:28
def U(*terms):
    """Union-sum of expressions (labels missing in one term count as zero)."""
    return reduce(lambda a, b: a.keep_extras() + b.keep_extras(), terms)

_term_entries reeds/open/build_linopy.py

linopy: one term of a row as (row index, column label, value) triples. The coefficient table is inner-joined to the variable domain (renamed first) on their shared index columns, the column label is the variable's position in its domain, and the row index is sum_by (a GAMS sum) or the full joined index, renamed by post.

build_linopy.py:36
def _term_entries(name: str, term: Term, K: dict, labeled: dict[str, pl.DataFrame]) -> pl.DataFrame | None:
    if term.coef not in K or term.var not in labeled:
        return None
    df = K[term.coef]
    if df.height == 0:
        return None
    vd = labeled[term.var]
    if term.rename:
        vd = vd.rename(term.rename)
    common = [c for c in df.columns if c != "value" and c in vd.columns]
    if not common:
        raise ValueError(f"{name}: coefficient table {term.coef} shares no index column with {term.var}")
    joined = df.join(vd, on=common, how="inner")
    keys = term.sum_by or [c for c in joined.columns if c not in ("value", COL)]
    out = joined.select(keys + [COL, "value"])
    if term.post:
        out = out.rename(term.post)
    return out

_add_row reeds/open/build_linopy.py

linopy: build one constraint from the algebra Row. The row set is the sorted union of the term rows and the constant's rows; entries are summed per (row, column), packed into padded coefficient and label arrays over (row, _term) with label −1 for no variable, and added as expr sense −const.

build_linopy.py:56
def _add_row(lm: LinopyModel, name: str, row: Row, C: dict, K: dict, labeled: dict[str, pl.DataFrame]) -> None:
    if name not in C or C[name].height == 0:
        return
    parts = []
    for term in row.terms:
        entries = _term_entries(name, term, K, labeled)
        if entries is not None:
            parts.append(entries)
    const = K[row.const] if row.const else None
    if not parts and const is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{name}: no coefficient table and no constant; the row set is undefined")
    key_sets = [sorted(c for c in p.columns if c not in (COL, "value")) for p in parts]
    if const is not None:
        key_sets.append(sorted(c for c in const.columns if c != "value"))
    if any(k != key_sets[0] for k in key_sets):
        raise ValueError(f"{name}: terms carry different row indices {key_sets}")
    keys = [c for c in (parts[0] if parts else const).columns if c not in (COL, "value")]
    row_tables = [p.select(keys) for p in parts]
    if const is not None:
        row_tables.append(const.select(keys))
    rows = pl.concat(row_tables).unique().sort(keys).with_row_index(ROW)
    n = rows.height
    dim = f"{name}_idx"
    if parts:
        entries = (pl.concat([p.select(keys + [COL, "value"]) for p in parts])
                   .join(rows, on=keys, how="inner")
                   .group_by([ROW, COL]).agg(pl.col("value").sum())
                   .filter(pl.col("value") != 0.0)
                   .sort([ROW, COL])
                   .with_columns(pl.int_range(pl.len()).over(ROW).alias("_pos")))
        width = int(entries["_pos"].max()) + 1 if entries.height else 1
        coeffs = np.zeros((n, width))
        vars_ = np.full((n, width), -1, dtype=np.int64)
        r = entries[ROW].to_numpy()
        pos = entries["_pos"].to_numpy()
        coeffs[r, pos] = entries["value"].to_numpy()
        vars_[r, pos] = entries[COL].to_numpy()
    else:
        coeffs = np.zeros((n, 1))
        vars_ = np.full((n, 1), -1, dtype=np.int64)
    if const is not None:
        rhs_values = -(rows.join(const.select(keys + ["value"]), on=keys, how="left")
                       .with_columns(pl.col("value").fill_null(0.0))["value"].to_numpy())
    else:
        rhs_values = np.zeros(n)
    data = xr.Dataset({"coeffs": ((dim, "_term"), coeffs), "vars": ((dim, "_term"), vars_)},
                      coords={dim: pd.RangeIndex(n)})
    expr = linopy.LinearExpression(data, lm.m)
    rhs = xr.DataArray(rhs_values, dims=[dim], coords={dim: pd.RangeIndex(n)})
    lm.m.add_constraints(expr, row.sense, rhs, name=name)
    lm.row_dom[name] = rows.select(keys)

def lookup(df: pl.DataFrame, par: pl.DataFrame, on: list[str], name: str, fill: float | None = 0.0) -> pl.DataFrame:

def fsum_by(df: pl.DataFrame, keys: list[str], col: str = "value") -> pl.DataFrame:

gams_round reeds/open/derive.py

GAMS round(x, n): half away from zero, which differs from the round-half-to-even of polars and numpy.

derive.py:11
def gams_round(x: pl.Expr, n: int) -> pl.Expr:
    scale = 10.0 ** n
    return (pl.when(x >= 0)
            .then((x * scale + 0.5).floor() / scale)
            .otherwise(-((-x) * scale + 0.5).floor() / scale))

_assign reeds/open/derive_capacity.py

GAMS conditional assignment x(keys)$domain = new: rows of target inside domain are replaced by new, rows outside keep their old value, and zeros in new are dropped.

derive_capacity.py:18
def _assign(target: pl.DataFrame, new: pl.DataFrame, keys: list[str], domain: pl.DataFrame | None = None) -> pl.DataFrame:
    """GAMS assignment: rows of `target` inside `domain` are replaced by `new` (zeros dropped)."""
    if domain is None:
        domain = new.select(keys)
    else:
        new = new.join(domain.select(keys).unique(), on=keys, how="semi")
    kept = anti(target, domain, keys)
    return pl.concat([kept.select(keys + ["value"]), nonzero(new.select(keys + ["value"]))])
